title: Case 354: The Gilgo Beach Serial Killings (Part 2/2)

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，一名女性的遗体在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园中被发现。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她惨遭斩首，体内的血液已被排干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机，试图掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为“简·多伊”（无名氏）。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于查明了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但查明身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“Casefile Presents”推出的全新系列节目，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.zh: 有关警告信息，请查看您应用内或我们网站上本集节目的说明。

sentences.en: On the night of Thursday, December 13, 2012, 26-year-old Christopher Loeb left his mother's
sentences.zh: 2012年12月13日，星期四的夜晚，26岁的克里斯托弗·洛布离开了位于萨福克郡史密斯敦的母亲家，

sentences.en: residence in Smithtown, Suffolk County, and made his way to the neighbouring hamlet of St James.
sentences.zh: 前往邻近的圣詹姆斯小村庄。

sentences.en: Christopher was someone who was well known to the county's police.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗是当地警方非常熟悉的人物。

sentences.en: He struggled with heroin addiction and was on probation for theft-related felony convictions.
sentences.zh: 他深受海洛因成瘾的困扰，且因盗窃相关重罪正处于缓刑期。

sentences.en: He'd begun committing thefts to support his substance use and continued to do so after his release.
sentences.zh: 他为了维持毒瘾开始行窃，出狱后也并未收手。

sentences.en: Christopher would drive around Long Island, then park somewhere and walk up to parked cars, jiggling their door handles in the hopes of finding them unlocked.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗常开车在长岛四处游荡，然后找个地方停车，走到路边的车旁，摇动车门把手，希望能碰上没锁的车。

sentences.en: Sometimes he found electronics, wallets, or spare change that he could pocket.
sentences.zh: 有时他能顺走电子产品、钱包或零钱。

sentences.en: That was what he was doing that Thursday night.
sentences.zh: 那个周四的晚上，他做的正是这些勾当。

sentences.en: In the early hours of Friday morning, he attempted to open the door of a GMC Yukon.
sentences.zh: 周五凌晨，他试图打开一辆GMC育空SUV的车门。

sentences.en: Upon gaining access to the vehicle,
sentences.zh: 成功进入车内后，

sentences.en: Christopher grabbed a canvas duffel bag he saw lying on the back seat.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗抓起后座上放着的一个帆布行李袋。

sentences.en: When he got back home, he took the bag down to the basement.
sentences.zh: 回到家后，他把袋子带到了地下室。

sentences.en: Inside were a number of iteMs. There was a box of cigars, a humidor, toiletries including lubricants, some sex toys and several pornographic DVDs.
sentences.zh: 袋子里装了不少东西：一盒雪茄、一个雪茄保湿盒、包括润滑剂在内的洗漱用品、一些性玩具以及几张色情DVD。

sentences.en: There was also a gumbelt with two Glock 9mm magazines, handcuffs, and a whistle.
sentences.zh: 里面还有一条枪带，装着两个格洛克9毫米手枪弹匣、一副手铐和一个哨子。

sentences.en: Later that same morning, Christopher's parole officer showed up unannounced at the Smithtown home where Christopher lived with his mother.
sentences.zh: 当天晚些时候，克里斯托弗的假释官突然造访了他与母亲同住的史密斯敦住所。

sentences.en: He was promptly followed by several Suffolk County police officers.
sentences.zh: 紧随其后的是几名萨福克郡的警官。

sentences.en: Seeing their vehicles from his upstairs bedroom window, Christopher bolted.
sentences.zh: 从楼上卧室的窗户看到警车后，克里斯托弗夺路而逃。

sentences.en: He ran out the back door and made it about half a mile from his home to a wooded area.
sentences.zh: 他从后门跑出，逃离家门约半英里，躲进了一片树林。

sentences.en: The police, in hot pursuit, chased Christopher down and roughly cuffed his hands behind his back before dragging him back to his house and placing him on the couch in the den.
sentences.zh: 紧追不舍的警察追上了克里斯托弗，粗暴地将他的双手反铐在背后，随后将他拖回家中，按在客厅的沙发上。

sentences.en: Other officers who'd remained at the property were undertaking a search.
sentences.zh: 留在现场的其他警员正在进行搜查。

sentences.en: One of those present was Suffolk County's then Chief of Police, James Burke.
sentences.zh: 在场的人中，就有时任萨福克郡警察局长的詹姆斯·伯克。

sentences.en: The canvas bag that Christopher had stolen the night before was given to Burke before it had been processed according to normal evidentiary procedures.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗前一晚偷走的那个帆布袋，在未经正常证据处理程序的情况下，直接交给了伯克。

sentences.en: According to Christopher Loeb, after he was subsequently taken into custody, James Burke confronted him in an interrogation
sentences.zh: 据克里斯托弗·洛布称，在他随后被拘留期间，詹姆斯·伯克在审讯室里与他当面对质，

sentences.en: room that had no video cameras and demanded, you want to fucking steal from me.
sentences.zh: 那间审讯室里没有监控摄像头，伯克质问道：“你他妈的竟敢偷到我头上。”

sentences.en: When the remains of 10 different people were recovered along Ocean Parkway in the spring of 2011,
sentences.zh: 2011年春天，当10名不同受害者的遗骸在海洋大道沿线被发现时，

sentences.en: Suffolk County Police Department was facing a case of mammoth proportions.
sentences.zh: 萨福克郡警察局正面临着一起规模巨大的案件。

sentences.en: However, the victims' families were hopeful that it would be solved soon.
sentences.zh: 然而，受害者家属们仍希望案件能很快告破。

sentences.en: The department was well-funded and resourced, with a homicide clearance rate of 74%, placing it well above the national average.
sentences.zh: 该局资金充足、资源丰富，凶杀案结案率高达74%，远高于全国平均水平。

sentences.en: But internal politics had been getting in the way of the investigation from the very start.
sentences.zh: 但从一开始，内部政治斗争就阻碍了调查的进行。

sentences.en: It began with the then-police chief Richard Dormer arguing publicly with district attorney Thomas Spoter over whether one killer was behind the murders or more.
sentences.zh: 起因是时任警察局长理查德·多默与地方检察官托马斯·斯波特公开争执，争论这些谋杀案究竟是一人所为还是多人所为。

sentences.en: According to journalist Robert Kolker, author of the book Lost Girls, this was partly due to Dormer being affiliated with a political rival of Spoter's.
sentences.zh: 据《迷失女孩》一书的作者、记者罗伯特·科尔克称，这部分是因为多默与斯波特的政敌有往来。

sentences.en: As Dormer was scheduled to retire at the end of 2011,
sentences.zh: 由于多默计划在2011年底退休，

sentences.en: Spoter was eager for the next police chief to be someone he could more easily sway and he already had someone in mind.
sentences.zh: 斯波特急于让下一任警察局长成为他更容易左右的人，而且他心中已经有了人选。

sentences.en: Thomas Spoter first met James Burke more than 30 years earlier when Spoter was prosecuting the April 1979 murder of a 13-year-old boy named Johnny Pius.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·斯波特与詹姆斯·伯克初次相识是在30多年前，当时斯波特正在起诉1979年4月一名13岁男孩约翰尼·皮乌斯的谋杀案。

sentences.en: Johnny had gone missing in Smithtown while riding his bicycle and was found the following morning dead in the grounds of a local elementary school.
sentences.zh: 约翰尼在史密斯敦骑自行车时失踪，次日清晨被发现死在当地一所小学的操场上。

sentences.en: Stones had been forced down his throat, asphyxiating him.
sentences.zh: 他的喉咙里被塞满了石头，导致窒息而死。

sentences.en: He had been beaten and stomped on, and his face was marked with the imprint of a sneaker.
sentences.zh: 他生前遭到殴打和践踏，脸上留下了运动鞋的鞋印。

sentences.en: The community was horrified by the brutal and senseless murder, and the pressure was on to find the killer.
sentences.zh: 这起残忍且毫无意义的谋杀案令社区感到震惊，寻找凶手的压力巨大。

sentences.en: Detectives were hopeful of obtaining a confession quickly.
sentences.zh: 侦探们希望能尽快获得供词。

sentences.en: At that time, the Suffolk County Police Department's Homicide Unit was renowned for having a confession rate of
sentences.zh: 当时，萨福克郡警察局的凶杀组以拥有97%的供词获取率而闻名，

sentences.en: 97%, three or four times that of most homicide units in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这是美国大多数凶杀组的三到四倍。

sentences.en: As author Robert Kolker explains, this extremely high figure is so improbable that it indicates
sentences.zh: 正如作者罗伯特·科尔克所解释的那样，这个极高的数字极其不合理，这表明

sentences.en: coercion was being used to force confessions, the result of an unchecked police force.
sentences.zh: 警方使用了胁迫手段来逼供，这是警权不受制约的结果。

sentences.en: Because Suffolk County's police union was wealthy, it was able to donate large sums of money to political campaigns
sentences.zh: 由于萨福克郡的警察工会财力雄厚，能够向政治竞选活动捐赠巨额资金，

sentences.en: This resulted in politicians being reluctant to challenge them, in turn allowing the department to get away with more than it should
sentences.zh: 这导致政客们不愿挑战他们，进而使警察局能够逍遥法外，做更多出格的事。

sentences.en: The sneaker imprint on Johnny's face convinced detectives that Johnny had most likely been murdered by another teenager
sentences.zh: 约翰尼脸上的鞋印让侦探们确信，约翰尼很可能是被另一名青少年谋杀的。

sentences.en: They began speaking to local youths, hoping somebody might know something and name those responsible
sentences.zh: 他们开始走访当地青年，希望有人能知情并供出肇事者。

sentences.en: Four teenage boys were soon implicated in the murder, with one confessing in the back of a police car
sentences.zh: 四名少年很快被卷入谋杀案，其中一人在警车后座上招供了。

sentences.en: His confession featured some inconsistent elements, however, and probably wouldn't be effective in a courtroom
sentences.zh: 然而，他的供词存在一些前后矛盾之处，在法庭上可能无法作为有效证据。

sentences.en: Thomas Spoter began seeking out other adolescents who might be able to act as witnesses and landed on then-16-year-old James Burke,
sentences.zh: 托马斯·斯波特开始寻找其他可能作为证人的青少年，并锁定了当时16岁的詹姆斯·伯克，

sentences.en: a juvenile delinquent involved in low-level burglaries and drug dealing.
sentences.zh: 一个涉及轻微盗窃和毒品交易的少年犯。

sentences.en: Burke willingly provided a story against the suspects, which some have deemed very convenient, and became a star witness in the case.
sentences.zh: 伯克心甘情愿地提供了针对嫌疑人的证词，有些人认为这太“凑巧”了，他因此成了该案的明星证人。

sentences.en: All four teenagers were convicted, though many held doubts about their guilt.
sentences.zh: 四名少年全部被定罪，尽管许多人对他们是否有罪存有疑虑。

sentences.en: And from that time on, Thomas Spoter became something of a mentor to James Burke.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，托马斯·斯波特就成了詹姆斯·伯克的导师。

sentences.en: Burke stopped dealing drugs and became a cop.
sentences.zh: 伯克停止了毒品交易，转而成为一名警察。

sentences.en: In 1986, when he was 21, he joined the Suffolk County Police Department and began rising through the ranks, being promoted to sergeant at age 26.
sentences.zh: 1986年，21岁的他加入了萨福克郡警察局，并开始步步高升，26岁时就晋升为警佐。

sentences.en: Burke had a natural intelligence and a strong knack for being a street cop, but his record was always spotty.
sentences.zh: 伯克天资聪颖，非常有当街头警察的天赋，但他的记录一直不太光彩。

sentences.en: He lost his department-issued firearm on more than one occasion.
sentences.zh: 他不止一次弄丢了警局配发的枪支。

sentences.en: In 1993, when Burke was 28, he was accused of smoking crack cocaine and having sex with a sex worker in his patrol car.
sentences.zh: 1993年，28岁的伯克被指控在巡逻车内吸食快克可卡因并与性工作者发生性关系。

sentences.en: This led to an investigation by Internal Affairs, and Thomas Spoter, who was by then working in a private practice, offered to represent Burke.
sentences.zh: 这引发了内务部的调查，而当时已在私人执业的托马斯·斯波特主动提出为伯克辩护。

sentences.en: Burke.
sentences.zh: 伯克。

sentences.en: Burke's punishment for his transgressions was the loss of 15 vacation days.
sentences.zh: 伯克因其违规行为受到的惩罚仅仅是扣除15天假期。

sentences.en: Former officers from the department who spoke to journalist Michael Edison Hayden for Vice described Burke as a sex-obsessed narcissiSt. There were rumours that he would shake down
sentences.zh: 曾向Vice新闻记者迈克尔·爱迪生·海登透露内情的该局前警官将伯克描述为一个沉迷于性的自恋狂。有传言称他会勒索

sentences.en: drug dealers for their contraband and then pocket them for his personal use.
sentences.zh: 毒贩，没收他们的违禁品，然后据为己有。

sentences.en: Throughout every scandal, Thomas Spoter had his back.
sentences.zh: 在每一次丑闻中，托马斯·斯波特都力挺他。

sentences.en: In 2002, Thomas Spoter became Suffolk County's district attorney and hired Burke to work in his office overseeing investigations.
sentences.zh: 2002年，托马斯·斯波特成为萨福克郡地方检察官，并聘请伯克进入办公室负责监督调查工作。

sentences.en: It seemed obvious to the rest of Spoter's staff that Spoter was grooming Burke to one day become the department's police chief, as soon as he could
sentences.zh: 斯波特手下的其他员工显然都看得出来，斯波特正在培养伯克，希望他有朝一日能成为警察局长，只要他能

sentences.en: exert influence over the appointment.
sentences.zh: 对任命施加影响。

sentences.en: That opportunity arrived a decade later in 2012, right as Suffolk County was facing its biggest crime in a generation, the Gilgo Beach serial killings.
sentences.zh: 这个机会在十年后的2012年到来了，当时萨福克郡正面临一代人以来最大的犯罪案件——吉尔戈海滩连环杀人案。

sentences.en: It was a huge case that required expertise on subjects such as cell phone data analysis and serial killer profiling.
sentences.zh: 这是一起需要手机数据分析和连环杀手侧写等专业知识的大案。

sentences.en: But instead of welcoming assistance from other law enforcement agencies such as the FBI who'd already started working the case,
sentences.zh: 但詹姆斯·伯克和托马斯·斯波特并没有欢迎联邦调查局（FBI）等已经开始介入此案的执法机构的协助，

sentences.en: James Burke and Thomas Spoter sent them away.
sentences.zh: 而是将他们拒之门外。

sentences.en: Before leaving, FBI agents handed over all of the work they'd done on the phone evidence
sentences.zh: 在离开之前，FBI探员移交了他们对手机证据所做的所有工作。

sentences.en: It was well known that the killer had used burner phones to contact his victims aware that he could be less easily traced this way
sentences.zh: 众所周知，凶手使用一次性手机联系受害者，因为他知道这样更难被追踪。

sentences.en: But it was likely that he still had a regular cell phone that he carried with him at the same time
sentences.zh: 但很可能他同时还随身携带一部常用手机。

sentences.en: FBI agents had been checking all of the towers that the killer's burner phones had been pinging off and had plans to search cell tower data in Long Island for other phones
sentences.zh: FBI探员一直在检查凶手一次性手机连接过的所有基站，并计划搜索长岛的基站数据，以查找其他

sentences.en: that had been hitting the same towers at the same time.
sentences.zh: 在同一时间连接过相同基站的手机。

sentences.en: By doing so, they hoped to come up with a list of possible suspects.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，他们希望能列出一份可能的嫌疑人名单。

sentences.en: The Suffolk County Police Department didn't continue this work, with Burke reportedly deeming it too invasive.
sentences.zh: 萨福克郡警察局并没有继续这项工作，据报道，伯克认为这太具侵入性了。

sentences.en: They had other leads they could pursue.
sentences.zh: 他们还有其他线索可以追查。

sentences.en: There was some physical evidence from the burial sites, including a distinctive leather belt embossed with two initials
sentences.zh: 在埋尸地点发现了一些物证，包括一条印有两个首字母的独特皮带，

sentences.en: and several hair strands that had been caught in duct tape or burlap that was used to bind the women.
sentences.zh: 以及几根粘在用于捆绑受害者的胶带或粗麻布上的头发。

sentences.en: And at least two of the victim's loved ones had received taunting calls from the killer.
sentences.zh: 而且至少有两名受害者的亲属曾接到过凶手的挑衅电话。

sentences.en: But overall, the investigation into the serial killings didn't appear to be a priority.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，对连环杀人案的调查似乎并非当务之急。

sentences.en: As Robert Kolker described in his book Lost Girls,
sentences.zh: 正如罗伯特·科尔克在《迷失女孩》一书中所述：

sentences.en: In the years that Burke ran the police department, the Gilgo Room at Suffolk Police Headquarters became a place for part-time work, with little urgency dictated from above.
sentences.zh: “在伯克掌管警察局的那些年里，萨福克警察总部的‘吉尔戈室’成了兼职办公的地方，上层几乎没有下达过任何紧迫的指令。”

sentences.en: Under Burke, the police were in what would later be characterised as a complete ethical freefall.
sentences.zh: 在伯克的领导下，警方陷入了后来被描述为彻底的道德沦丧。

sentences.en: In Colker's words, Burke turned the department into his own personal empire.
sentences.zh: 用科尔克的话说，伯克把警察局变成了他个人的帝国。

sentences.en: He ordered officers to follow and watch his girlfriend, her ex-partners, and her son.
sentences.zh: 他命令警官跟踪并监视他的女友、她的前任以及她的儿子。

sentences.en: He also punished colleagues he considered disloyal.
sentences.zh: 他还惩罚了他认为不忠的同事。

sentences.en: Every night, drinks were served in his office.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，他的办公室里都会供应酒水。

sentences.en: Burke's mentor and number one ally, Thomas Spoter, also prioritised investigating perceived adversaries over the Gilgo investigation.
sentences.zh: 伯克的导师兼头号盟友托马斯·斯波特，也将调查所谓的政敌置于吉尔戈案件调查之上。

sentences.en: With the police department operating in such close concert with the district attorney's office, there was even less scrutiny from the outside than there had been before.
sentences.zh: 由于警察局与地方检察官办公室配合得如此紧密，外界的监督比以往任何时候都要少。

sentences.en: Until that suddenly changed about a year into James Burke's term.
sentences.zh: 直到詹姆斯·伯克任期约一年时，这种情况突然发生了改变。

sentences.en: When Christopher Loeb went out looking for cars to steal from on the night of Thursday December 13,
sentences.zh: 当克里斯托弗·洛布在2012年12月13日星期四晚上出去寻找目标车辆行窃时，

sentences.en: 2012, he had no idea that one SUV he stole a duffel bag from was the department-issued vehicle of Suffolk County's chief of police.
sentences.zh: 他根本不知道自己偷走帆布袋的那辆SUV，竟然是萨福克郡警察局长的公务用车。

sentences.en: It is unclear how police identified Christopher as the culprit, but by the following morning, they were at his mother's home searching the
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚警方是如何确定克里斯托弗就是罪魁祸首的，但到第二天早上，他们已经来到他母亲家，搜查

sentences.en: property for the stolen items and placing Christopher under arreSt. After Christopher
sentences.zh: 被盗物品并将克里斯托弗逮捕。在克里斯托弗

sentences.en: Loeb was transferred to a nearby precinct for questioning, the police aggression towards him only increased.
sentences.zh: 洛布被转移到附近的警局接受审讯后，警方对他的暴力行为变本加厉。

sentences.en: He was handcuffed and chained to the floor of an interrogation room without cameras for 10 hours.
sentences.zh: 他被戴上手铐，锁在没有摄像头的审讯室地板上长达10个小时。

sentences.en: Over that period, James Burke and some detectives repeatedly beat and kicked Christopher.
sentences.zh: 在此期间，詹姆斯·伯克和几名侦探反复殴打并踢踹克里斯托弗。

sentences.en: One detective threatened to rape his mother while Burke said he'd murder him with a hotshot, an overdose of heroin that would look like an accident.
sentences.zh: 一名侦探威胁要强奸他的母亲，而伯克则说他会用“热弹”（过量海洛因）杀了他，让死因看起来像是一场意外。

sentences.en: Understanding that Burke was the owner of the duffel bag that contained various sex toys and pornographic DVDs,
sentences.zh: 由于知道伯克就是那个装有各种性玩具和色情DVD的帆布袋的主人，

sentences.en: Christopher called the police chief a pervert.
sentences.zh: 克里斯托弗骂警察局长是个变态。

sentences.en: In response, James Burke punched him in the face.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，詹姆斯·伯克一拳打在他的脸上。

sentences.en: Several days after the beating, James Burke bragged that the incident had reminded him of his old days as a younger cop
sentences.zh: 殴打事件发生几天后，詹姆斯·伯克吹嘘说，这件事让他想起了自己年轻时当警察的日子。

sentences.en: He referred to the other officers who'd helped him as his palace guard
sentences.zh: 他把那些协助他的警官称为他的“御林军”。

sentences.en: But this was the beginning of the end for James Burke
sentences.zh: 但这却是詹姆斯·伯克末日的开始。

sentences.en: The FBI had caught wind of the assault against Christopher Loeb almost immediately and opened an investigation into the matter alongside the US Attorney's Office
sentences.zh: FBI几乎立即就获悉了针对克里斯托弗·洛布的袭击事件，并与美国检察官办公室一起对此展开了调查。

sentences.en: They found evidence that Burke had pressured detectives to lie about the assault and instructed them to agree to a false version of events.
sentences.zh: 他们发现了证据，证明伯克曾向侦探施压，要求他们对袭击事件撒谎，并指示他们统一口径，编造虚假的事件版本。

sentences.en: One of those detectives later lied under oath that Christopher Loeb had not been assaulted.
sentences.zh: 其中一名侦探后来在宣誓后撒谎称，克里斯托弗·洛布没有受到袭击。

sentences.en: The case finally broke open when an informant admitted the truth.
sentences.zh: 当一名线人承认了真相后，案件终于取得了突破。

sentences.en: In December 2015, James Burke was arrested and charged with the assault of Christopher Loeb, as well as civil rights violations and conspiracy to obstruct a federal investigation.
sentences.zh: 2015年12月，詹姆斯·伯克被捕，并被控袭击克里斯托弗·洛布，以及侵犯公民权利和密谋妨碍联邦调查。

sentences.en: Burke later pleaded guilty to reduced charges and was sentenced to 46 months in federal prison.
sentences.zh: 伯克后来对减轻后的指控认罪，被判处46个月联邦监禁。

sentences.en: Thomas Spoter, whose staff had helped Burke in his attempted cover-up, was subsequently indicted for witness tampering, conspiracy and obstruction of justice.
sentences.zh: 托马斯·斯波特，其手下曾协助伯克试图掩盖罪行，随后因篡改证人、密谋和妨碍司法公正而被起诉。

sentences.en: He too was convicted in a federal court and subsequently sentenced to five years.
sentences.zh: 他也在联邦法院被判有罪，随后被判处五年监禁。

sentences.en: The entire fiasco had left Suffolk County in complete disarray and still there was more that would emerge about James Burke.
sentences.zh: 整场闹剧让萨福克郡陷入了彻底的混乱，而关于詹姆斯·伯克还有更多内幕浮出水面。

sentences.en: After another year dragged on with no developments in the Gilgo Beach serial killings case, John Ray, the attorney for Shannon Gilbert's mother,
sentences.zh: 在吉尔戈海滩连环杀人案又拖了一年毫无进展后，香农·吉尔伯特母亲的律师约翰·雷，

sentences.en: Marie, held a bombshell press conference on Thursday December 15, 2016.
sentences.zh: 于2016年12月15日星期四举行了一场重磅新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Sitting beside him was a woman named Leanne.
sentences.zh: 坐在他身边的是一位名叫莉安的女性。

sentences.zh: 她是一名长岛的性工作者，她声称詹姆斯·

sentences.zh: 吉尔戈海滩发现尸体之后，但在那年年底发现香农之前。

sentences.en: A former confidential informant, Leanne said that she'd met James Burke at a party in Oak Beach, the same gated community where Shannon Gilbert had gone missing.
sentences.zh: 作为一名前机密线人，莉安说她是在橡树滩的一个派对上认识詹姆斯·伯克的，那里正是香农·吉尔伯特失踪的同一个封闭式社区。

sentences.en: She claimed that when Burke had been unable to perform sexually, he became angry and aggressive, telling Leanne that she was not a, quote, good whore.
sentences.zh: 她声称，当伯克无法进行性行为时，他变得愤怒且具有攻击性，告诉莉安她不是一个“好的妓女”。

sentences.en: When a journalist asked whether Burke ever mentioned the Gilgo case to Leanne, she replied, no, but he seemed to like to choke me.
sentences.zh: 当记者问及伯克是否曾向莉安提及吉尔戈案件时，她回答说：“没有，但他似乎喜欢掐我的脖子。”

sentences.en: Leanne added that she also had several other Suffolk County cops as clients, despite sex work
sentences.zh: 莉安补充说，尽管性工作在纽约州是非法的，但她还有几位萨福克郡的警察客户，

sentences.en: being illegal in New York State, and she'd seen James Burke grab a woman by her hair and push her to the ground.
sentences.zh: 而且她曾亲眼见过詹姆斯·伯克抓住一名女性的头发并将她推倒在地。

sentences.en: Attorney John Ray pointed out that now a direct correlation had been made between
sentences.zh: 律师约翰·雷指出，现在已经建立了伯克、针对性工作者的暴力行为以及吉尔戈案件之间的直接联系，

sentences.en: Burke, violence against sex workers, and the Gilgo case, via his attendance at an Oak Beach party where sex workers were present.
sentences.zh: 因为他曾出席过有性工作者在场的橡树滩派对。

sentences.en: Following this press conference, speculation by armchair detectives and others who'd been watching the Gilgo case went into overdrive.
sentences.zh: 此次新闻发布会后，业余侦探和其他一直关注吉尔戈案件的人的猜测达到了顶峰。

sentences.en: Some believed that James Burke was the serial killer himself, or knew who the killer was, and that was why he deliberately thwarted the investigation.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为詹姆斯·伯克本人就是连环杀手，或者知道凶手是谁，这就是他故意阻挠调查的原因。

sentences.en: He was covering up for himself for a friend.
sentences.zh: 他是在为自己或朋友掩盖罪行。

sentences.en: Burke's attorneys called this theory preposterous, stating,
sentences.zh: 伯克的律师称这种理论荒谬至极，并表示：

sentences.en: There is absolutely not one shred of evidence linking him to the Gilgo Beach case.
sentences.zh: “绝对没有任何证据将他与吉尔戈海滩案件联系起来。”

sentences.en: There was no evidence suggesting that James Burke was a killer, but his relationships with
sentences.zh: 虽然没有证据表明詹姆斯·伯克是杀手，但他与

sentences.en: sex workers and habit of using illegal drugs had played a part in his lacklustre leadership regarding the Gilgo investigation.
sentences.zh: 性工作者的关系以及使用非法毒品的习惯，确实导致了他在吉尔戈案件调查中表现出的领导力匮乏。

sentences.en: Burke's corrupt behaviour was most likely why he hadn't wanted the FBI involved in the case, to prevent them from discovering what he'd been up to.
sentences.zh: 伯克的腐败行为很可能就是他不希望FBI介入此案的原因，目的是防止他们发现他的所作所为。

sentences.en: It was also indicative of his attitude towards the Gilgo victiMs.
sentences.zh: 这也反映了他对待吉尔戈受害者的态度。

sentences.en: In the Netflix documentary series Gone Girls, former Suffolk County detective Rob Trotter said,
sentences.zh: 在Netflix纪录片系列《消失的女孩》中，前萨福克郡侦探罗伯·特罗特说：

sentences.en: After James Burke was indicted and left the Suffolk County Police Department in disgrace, an outsider was brought in to be the new chief.
sentences.zh: “在詹姆斯·伯克被起诉并蒙羞离开萨福克郡警察局后，一位局外人被请来担任新局长。”

sentences.en: Tim Siney was a senior prosecutor from the US Attorney's Office in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·西尼是来自曼哈顿美国检察官办公室的一名高级检察官。

sentences.en: He brought the FBI back into the investigation and they resumed their work on the burner phone data.
sentences.zh: 他让联邦调查局重新介入调查，他们恢复了对一次性手机数据的分析工作。

sentences.en: Cell tower triangulation had allowed them to create rough maps of where the killer had likely been using his burner phones from in Midtown Manhattan and Long Island.
sentences.zh: 通过手机信号塔三角定位，他们绘制出了凶手在曼哈顿中城和长岛使用一次性手机的大致活动范围。

sentences.en: It had long been thought that the killer probably worked in the former and lived in the latter.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，人们一直认为凶手可能在前者工作，住在后者。

sentences.en: Using specialised equipment, they were able to refine this data even further, localising to more precise areas.
sentences.zh: 利用专业设备，他们能够进一步细化这些数据，将范围锁定在更精确的区域。

sentences.en: Ultimately, they came up with a radius that had the Nassau County suburb of Massapequa Park at its centre, as the burner and victim's phones had pinged a cell tower in that area.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们确定了一个以拿骚县马萨皮夸公园郊区为中心的半径范围，因为凶手和受害者的手机都曾连接过该区域的信号塔。

sentences.en: Massapequa Park also sat directly across the bay from Gilgo Beach giving someone who lived there greater familiarity with the dump site
sentences.zh: 马萨皮夸公园与吉尔戈海滩隔湾相望，这让住在那里的人对抛尸地点更加熟悉。

sentences.en: There were roughly 500 residents included in this tight geographic zone and the area was home to less than 1,000 men
sentences.zh: 在这个狭小的地理区域内大约有500名居民，其中男性不到1000人。

sentences.en: If the police could identify which of these men worked in New York City they might have a short list of suspects
sentences.zh: 如果警方能查出这些人中有谁在纽约市工作，或许就能列出一份简短的嫌疑人名单。

sentences.en: However, the Suffolk County force had butted heads with Tim Seney since his arrival, seeing him as an outsider, and resisted many of his investigative efforts.
sentences.zh: 然而，萨福克县警方自蒂姆·塞尼上任以来就与他意见不合，视他为外人，并抵制他的许多调查工作。

sentences.en: He left the job of police chief in 2018 after being elected as district attorney.
sentences.zh: 他在当选地区检察官后，于2018年辞去了警察局长的职务。

sentences.en: Seney was replaced as police chief by Geraldine Hart, the first woman to hold the position, and the former head of the FBI's Long Island Bureau.
sentences.zh: 接替塞尼担任警察局长的是杰拉尔丁·哈特，她是首位担任该职位的女性，曾任联邦调查局长岛分局局长。

sentences.en: She had already worked on the investigation.
sentences.zh: 她之前就参与过这项调查。

sentences.en: but had been removed from it by James Burke when he decided to exclude all other agencies.
sentences.zh: 但当詹姆斯·伯克决定排斥所有其他机构时，她被踢出了调查组。

sentences.en: Now, as police chief herself, Hart decided to utilise genetic genealogy to try to identify the unknown victims found along Ocean Parkway.
sentences.zh: 如今，身为警察局长的哈特决定利用基因谱系学，试图查明在海洋大道沿线发现的无名受害者身份。

sentences.en: Genetic genealogy was being touted as a powerful new investigative tool after it led to the identification of the Golden State Killer in California, covered in case 53 of Casefile.
sentences.zh: 在基因谱系学帮助破获加州“金州杀手”案（Casefile第53集）后，它被誉为一种强大的新型调查工具。

sentences.en: Geraldine Hart commissioned an outside lab to go over the DNA evidence in the Gilgo case and in 2020, this led to the identification of Jane Doe No.
sentences.zh: 杰拉尔丁·哈特委托一家外部实验室重新审查吉尔戈案中的DNA证据，这在2020年促成了对无名氏6号的身份确认。

sentences.en: She was one of two victims who'd had some remains discarded along Ocean Parkway and the rest of her body left in a wooded area of Manorville, about 45 miles east of Gilgo Beach.
sentences.zh: 她是两名遗骸被丢弃在海洋大道沿线的受害者之一，其余遗体则被留在吉尔戈海滩以东约45英里的马诺维尔林区。

sentences.en: Jane Doe No.
sentences.zh: 无名氏

sentences.zh: 6号被确认为瓦莱丽·

sentences.zh: 麦克，一名来自费城的24岁女性，于2000年底失踪。

sentences.en: Like all of the other victims, Valerie had been petite, standing five feet tall and weighing 110 pounds.
sentences.zh: 和其他受害者一样，瓦莱丽身材娇小，身高5英尺，体重110磅。

sentences.en: She had lived in a number of foster homes as a child before being adopted by the Mack family.
sentences.zh: 她在童年时期住过多家寄养家庭，后来被麦克一家收养。

sentences.en: Valerie Mack became a mother to a son when she was 17 and lived for a time with her child's father in New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 瓦莱丽·麦克在17岁时生下了一个儿子，并曾与孩子父亲在新泽西州生活过一段时间。

sentences.en: She got a tattoo of her son's name on her right ankle
sentences.zh: 她在右脚踝上纹了儿子的名字。

sentences.en: Between 1996, when she was 19, and 2000
sentences.zh: 在1996年她19岁到2000年之间，

sentences.en: Valerie was arrested several times in Philadelphia for sex work-related offences
sentences.zh: 瓦莱丽在费城因涉嫌性工作相关罪行被捕过多次。

sentences.en: She was also thought to sometimes work in Atlantic City, New Jersey
sentences.zh: 据信她有时也会在新泽西州的大西洋城工作。

sentences.en: Now investigators believed she had somehow fallen victim to the Long Island serial killer
sentences.zh: 现在调查人员认为，她以某种方式成为了长岛连环杀手的受害者。

sentences.en: In the hopes of generating a lead from someone close to the killer,
sentences.zh: 为了从凶手身边的人那里获得线索，

sentences.en: Geraldine Hart went public with a piece of evidence that had been kept under wraps, a leather belt that had been used to bind Maureen Brainard Barnes.
sentences.zh: 杰拉尔丁·哈特公开了一件一直被保密的证据：一条曾用于捆绑莫琳·布雷纳德·巴恩斯的皮带。

sentences.en: It was a distinctive belt due to the fact that one end had been embossed with the owner's initials,
sentences.zh: 这条皮带很有辨识度，因为其中一端压印着主人的姓名首字母，

sentences.zh: 从不同角度看，可能是HM或WH。

sentences.zh: 哈特局长向公众分享了皮带的照片，希望有人能认出它。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, no leads resulted and the case continued to stagnate.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，没有产生任何线索，案件继续陷入停滞。

sentences.en: The tide finally turned in 2021 when a new district attorney was elected in Suffolk County.
sentences.zh: 直到2021年萨福克县选出新任地区检察官，局势才终于出现转机。

sentences.en: Ray Tierney campaigned heavily on the platform that he wanted the Gilgo case solved and met with some of the victim's family members.
sentences.zh: 雷·蒂尔尼在竞选时大力宣扬他要破获吉尔戈案的纲领，并会见了一些受害者的家属。

sentences.en: After he took office at the beginning of 2022, he was joined by yet another new police chief,
sentences.zh: 他在2022年初上任后，又迎来了一位新的警察局长，

sentences.en: a veteran investigator named Rodney Harrison, who'd spent years with the New York Police
sentences.zh: 一位名叫罗德尼·哈里森的资深调查员，他曾在纽约警察局工作多年，

sentences.zh: 是首位被任命为萨福克县警察局长的非裔美国人。

sentences.en: On Harrison's very first day in the role, he visited the site at Gilgo Beach where the bodies had been found.
sentences.zh: 哈里森上任的第一天，就亲自前往发现尸体的吉尔戈海滩现场。

sentences.en: He was stunned to learn that the case file for the Long Island serial killer case hadn't been digitised.
sentences.zh: 他震惊地发现，长岛连环杀手案的卷宗竟然没有数字化。

sentences.en: This meant that all of the notes, interview transcripts and witness statements relating to the crime were available in paper form only and couldn't be easily searched.
sentences.zh: 这意味着所有与案件相关的笔记、审讯笔录和证人陈述都只有纸质版，无法轻易检索。

sentences.en: Chief Harrison arranged for everything to be sent to the FBI's headquarters in Quantico, Virginia, for digitisation.
sentences.zh: 哈里森局长安排将所有资料送到位于弗吉尼亚州匡蒂科的联邦调查局总部进行数字化处理。

sentences.en: He and D.A.
sentences.zh: 他和蒂尔尼检察官

sentences.en: Tierney also wanted a special task force to be dedicated entirely to the investigation.
sentences.zh: 还希望成立一个专门负责此案的特别工作组。

sentences.en: Chief Harrison's experience in New York City had taught him that collaborating with other agencies could be the key to solving a case.
sentences.zh: 哈里森局长在纽约市的经验告诉他，与其他机构合作可能是破案的关键。

sentences.en: The task force would comprise investigators from numerous agencies, from the State Police and Nassau County, as well as Suffolk County Police and Sheriff's Departments,
sentences.zh: 该工作组将由来自众多机构的调查人员组成，包括州警察局、拿骚县警察局、萨福克县警察局和治安官办公室，

sentences.en: and the FBI.
sentences.zh: 以及联邦调查局。

sentences.zh: 该工作组于2022年2月15日星期二宣布成立。

sentences.zh: 不到一个月，他们就获得了一条重大线索。

sentences.en: Amber had been the last of the four women to go missing, disappearing after an appointment with a client on Thursday September 2, 2010,
sentences.zh: 安珀是四名失踪女性中最后一位，她在2010年9月2日星期四与客户见面后失踪，

sentences.en: roughly three months before her body was found.
sentences.zh: 大约三个月后她的尸体被发现。

sentences.en: At the time of her murder, Amber had been living in West Babylon, a town in Suffolk County, in Dave Shuller's residence
sentences.zh: 谋杀发生时，安珀住在萨福克县西巴比伦的戴夫·沙勒家中。

sentences.en: Detectives visited the house and interviewed Dave
sentences.zh: 侦探们走访了这所房子并采访了戴夫。

sentences.en: He told them about the days leading up to Amber's disappearance
sentences.zh: 他向他们讲述了安珀失踪前几天的情况。

sentences.en: And how, just one day before she went missing, the two of them had carried out a scam that they employed from time to time
sentences.zh: 以及就在她失踪前一天，他们两人如何实施了一个他们偶尔会用的骗局。

sentences.en: A client that Amber had been communicating with showed up to collect her, and after he paid, Dave jumped out, pretending to be her angry spouse
sentences.zh: 安珀一直在联系的一位客户出现并接她，在他付钱后，戴夫跳了出来，假装是她愤怒的配偶。

sentences.en: This enabled Amber to take the client's money without having to have sex with him
sentences.zh: 这让安珀在不必与客户发生性关系的情况下拿到了钱。

sentences.en: Dave and Amber had done this a few times, sex work clients were easy to scam because they weren't likely to go to the authorities to report the crime
sentences.zh: 戴夫和安珀这样做过几次，性工作客户很容易被骗，因为他们不太可能去当局举报犯罪。

sentences.en: One thing that struck Dave about the man he and Amber stole from that night was how big he was.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，戴夫对那个被他们偷钱的男人印象最深的一点是他的体型非常大。

sentences.en: The word Dave used to describe him was ogre.
sentences.zh: 戴夫用来形容他的词是“食人魔”。

sentences.en: He was between 6 foot 4 and 6 foot 6 with a broad build looming over both of them.
sentences.zh: 他身高在6英尺4英寸到6英尺6英寸之间，体格宽大，笼罩着他们两人。

sentences.en: A white man in his mid-40s, he also had dark bushy hair and big
sentences.zh: 一个40多岁的白人男子，留着浓密的深色头发，戴着一副大大的

sentences.en: 1970s style oval eyeglasses.
sentences.zh: 70年代风格的椭圆形眼镜。

sentences.en: Dave also told police that he'd seen the man's SUV parked in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 戴夫还告诉警方，他看到那个男人的SUV停在车道上。

sentences.en: It was a dark green first generation Chevy Avalanche.
sentences.zh: 那是一辆深绿色的第一代雪佛兰雪崩。

sentences.en: The following night, Dave had seen the car again.
sentences.zh: 第二天晚上，戴夫又看到了那辆车。

sentences.en: Amber had made plans to see the same client after he texted her to say, that was not nice, so do I credit for next time.
sentences.zh: 安珀计划再次见那位客户，因为他发短信说：“那次不太愉快，下次能抵扣吗？”

sentences.en: Amber agreed to meet the client down the street, possibly because he'd told her he didn't want to see her angry boyfriend again.
sentences.zh: 安珀同意在街头与客户见面，可能是因为他告诉她不想再见到她那个愤怒的男朋友了。

sentences.en: Dave had escorted Amber as far as the letterbox, then turned to see the same dark-coloured SUV drive past the house a minute later.
sentences.zh: 戴夫把安珀送到邮箱处，一分钟后转身看到同一辆深色SUV从房子前驶过。

sentences.en: Dave never saw Amber again.
sentences.zh: 戴夫再也没见过安珀。

sentences.en: The description of the client and his car were a decent lead, and detectives in 2011 set about
sentences.zh: 对客户及其车辆的描述是一个不错的线索，2011年的侦探们开始着手

sentences.en: searching for his vehicle registration via New York State's Department of Motor Vehicles or DMV records.
sentences.zh: 通过纽约州机动车管理局（DMV）的记录搜索他的车辆登记信息。

sentences.en: But they found nothing and the lead went nowhere.
sentences.zh: 但他们一无所获，线索中断了。

sentences.en: Journalist Robert Kolker reported that a source told him the Chevy Avalanche had likely been miscategorised by the DMV as it was a kind of hybrid of a car and a truck.
sentences.zh: 记者罗伯特·科尔克报道称，一位消息人士告诉他，雪佛兰雪崩很可能被DMV错误分类了，因为它介于轿车和卡车之间。

sentences.en: Despite having a description of an ogre-like person of interest and his vehicle, the Suffolk County detectives hadn't passed this tip on to higher-ups at the
sentences.zh: 尽管掌握了“食人魔”般嫌疑人的描述及其车辆信息，萨福克县的侦探们并没有将此线索上报给

sentences.en: department or any outside agencies such as the FBI.
sentences.zh: 部门高层或联邦调查局等外部机构。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, Dave Schaller's information was buried in a file filled with hundreds of documents.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，戴夫·沙勒的信息一直埋藏在装满数百份文件的档案中。

sentences.en: Until Monday, March 14,
sentences.zh: 直到2022年3月14日星期一，

sentences.en: 2022, when the new task force dedicated to the Gilgo Beach case discovered it in their new digital case file.
sentences.zh: 专门负责吉尔戈海滩案的新工作组在他们新的数字卷宗中发现了它。

sentences.en: A member of the state police who was working with the task force searched for first-generation dark green Chevrolet avalanches in a private subscription-based vehicle database
sentences.zh: 一名与工作组合作的州警在一个私人订阅制的车辆数据库中搜索了第一代深绿色雪佛兰雪崩，

sentences.en: that was more comprehensive than New York's DMV records.
sentences.zh: 该数据库比纽约DMV的记录更全面。

sentences.en: He got a hit immediately.
sentences.zh: 他立即有了发现。

sentences.en: At the time of the murders, a green Chevrolet avalanche had been registered to a man living in Massapequa Park in Nassau County.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生时，一辆绿色雪佛兰雪崩登记在一名居住在拿骚县马萨皮夸公园的男子名下。

sentences.en: Two of the victim's phones had pinged cell towers in this same suburban neighbourhood after they'd gone missing, and the man's home was at the centre
sentences.zh: 其中两名受害者的手机在她们失踪后曾连接过这个郊区社区的信号塔，而该男子的家正处于

sentences.en: of the geographic area where investigators had suspected the killer lived.
sentences.zh: 调查人员怀疑凶手居住的地理区域中心。

sentences.en: The owner of the avalanche had purchased it from a Long Island dealership in 2002.
sentences.zh: 这辆雪崩的主人于2002年从长岛的一家经销商处购买了它。

sentences.en: A Google map photograph of the man's house taken in November of 2011 showed the Chevy parked on the street out the front.
sentences.zh: 2011年11月拍摄的该男子房屋的谷歌地图照片显示，这辆雪佛兰停在前面的街道上。

sentences.en: In 2012, more than a year into the Gilgo Beach investigation, the man had transferred the
sentences.zh: 2012年，在吉尔戈海滩调查进行一年多后，该男子将

sentences.en: vehicle's ownership and registration to his brother, who lived several states away in South
sentences.zh: 车辆的所有权和登记转让给了他住在几个州之外南卡罗来纳州的兄弟。

sentences.en: Carolina.
sentences.zh: 南卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: Looking into the man who had originally owned the avalanche, investigators saw that he was a perfect match to the physical description Dave Schaller had given.
sentences.zh: 调查人员调查了最初拥有这辆雪崩的男子，发现他与戴夫·沙勒提供的体貌特征完全吻合。

sentences.en: He had the same tall, hulking build, was white with a dark mop of hair, wore large eyeglasses, and would have been in his mid-forties 12 years earlier when Amber went missing.
sentences.zh: 他身材高大魁梧，白人，留着浓密的深色头发，戴着大眼镜，12年前安珀失踪时他正好40多岁。

sentences.en: Moreover, he resided in Long Island and worked in Midtown Manhattan, just as investigators had suspected based on the cell phone data.
sentences.zh: 此外，他住在长岛，在曼哈顿中城工作，正如调查人员根据手机数据所怀疑的那样。

sentences.en: The man's name was Rex Hewerman.
sentences.zh: 这名男子的名字叫雷克斯·赫尔曼。

sentences.en: Born on September 13, 1963, Rex Hewerman was born and raised in Massapequa Park, a leafy, middle-class neighbourhood on Long Island's South
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·赫尔曼出生于1963年9月13日，在长岛南岸一个绿树成荫的中产阶级社区马萨皮夸公园出生长大。

sentences.en: Shore.
sentences.zh: 岸。

sentences.en: His father, Theodore, was an aerospace engineer who served in the United States Air Force during World War II.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲西奥多是一名航空工程师，二战期间曾在美军服役。

sentences.en: Hewerman was one of five children.
sentences.zh: 赫尔曼是五个孩子中的一个。

sentences.en: He had three older sisters and a younger brother.
sentences.zh: 他有三个姐姐和一个弟弟。

sentences.en: He clashed with his father, who could be domineering and critical of his son.
sentences.zh: 他与父亲关系紧张，父亲性格专横，对他要求苛刻。

sentences.en: Hulman desperately wanted to follow in his father's footsteps by joining the Air Force, but he had dyslexia, which presented an obstacle.
sentences.zh: 赫尔曼非常想追随父亲的脚步加入空军，但他患有阅读障碍，这成了一个障碍。

sentences.en: Theodore was disappointed by this.
sentences.zh: 西奥多对此感到失望。

sentences.en: Hulman's relationship with his mother Dolores wasn't much better.
sentences.zh: 赫尔曼与母亲多洛雷斯的关系也没好到哪去。

sentences.en: He felt as though she was emotionally unavailable and self-absorbed.
sentences.zh: 他觉得母亲情感冷漠，自私自利。

sentences.en: He began to act out by doing things like shoplifting.
sentences.zh: 他开始通过偷窃等行为来发泄。

sentences.en: In 1975, when Hewerman was 12 years old, his father died.
sentences.zh: 1975年，赫尔曼12岁时，父亲去世了。

sentences.en: His mother continued to raise her children in the same Mesopequa Park home on First Avenue, a modest, wood-panelled ranch-style house.
sentences.zh: 母亲继续在第一大道的老房子里抚养孩子们，那是一栋朴素的木板外墙牧场式住宅。

sentences.en: Rex Hewerman's school life was even worse than the struggles he'd faced at home.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·赫尔曼的学校生活比他在家里的挣扎还要糟糕。

sentences.en: A loner and an outsider who stood out due to his exceptional height and awkward demeanour, he was often picked on by other children.
sentences.zh: 他是一个孤独的局外人，因身材异常高大和举止笨拙而显得格格不入，经常被其他孩子欺负。

sentences.en: A group of them set upon him in the sixth grade trying to beat him up but were stopped by a teacher.
sentences.zh: 六年级时，一群孩子围住他试图殴打他，但被一名老师制止了。

sentences.en: In addition to facing physical attacks,
sentences.zh: 除了面临身体攻击，

sentences.en: Hewerman was on the receiving end of verbal insults, with one classmate telling the New York times.
sentences.zh: 赫尔曼还遭受言语侮辱，一位同学告诉《纽约时报》：

sentences.en: He got picked on a lot.
sentences.zh: “他经常被欺负。”

sentences.en: He would take it and take it and walk away.
sentences.zh: “他总是默默忍受，然后走开。”

sentences.en: I seen him pushed to his limit.
sentences.zh: “我见过他被逼到极限的样子。”

sentences.en: As he grew older, Hewlett's physical stature became more imposing, but he remained quiet and insecure.
sentences.zh: 随着年龄增长，赫尔曼的体格变得更加魁梧，但他依然沉默寡言且缺乏自信。

sentences.en: When classmates did try to talk to him, he had difficulty holding a conversation.
sentences.zh: 当同学试图与他交谈时，他很难维持对话。

sentences.en: He avoided school sports and other extracurricular activities, but did join the drama club where he worked as a stagehand.
sentences.zh: 他避开了学校体育和其他课外活动，但加入了戏剧社，担任舞台工作人员。

sentences.en: He didn't socialise and amongst some of his peers, he developed a reputation for having a mean streak.
sentences.zh: 他不善社交，在一些同龄人中，他以性格刻薄而闻名。

sentences.en: One thing at school that Hewerman did seem to like was architectural drawing class.
sentences.zh: 赫尔曼在学校似乎唯一喜欢的就是建筑制图课。

sentences.en: After he graduated, he studied architecture at the New York Institute of Technology.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，他在纽约理工学院学习建筑学。

sentences.en: He became an architect and then an architectural consultant and in 1994, he opened his own firm on Fifth Avenue in Midtown Manhattan, calling it RH Consultants and Associates.
sentences.zh: 他成为了一名建筑师，后来又成为建筑顾问。1994年，他在曼哈顿中城的第五大道开设了自己的公司，取名为RH咨询与合伙人公司。

sentences.en: His job was to oversee renovations to ensure they followed the proper building codes.
sentences.zh: 他的工作是监督翻修工程，确保它们符合适当的建筑规范。

sentences.en: That same year, Hewerman purchased his childhood home from his mother for $170,000, taking over the single-family residence on First Avenue.
sentences.zh: 同年，赫尔曼以17万美元的价格从母亲手中买下了童年故居，接管了第一大道上的这栋单户住宅。

sentences.en: He caught the train every day from Massapequa Park to his office near Penn Station.
sentences.zh: 他每天从马萨皮夸公园乘火车去宾州车站附近的办公室。

sentences.en: Two years later, in April 1996, he married Arsa Elrup, who was one month his junior.
sentences.zh: 两年后，即1996年4月，他娶了比他小一个月的阿萨·埃尔鲁普。

sentences.en: Arsa had been born in Iceland, but was put up for adoption along with her little brother.
sentences.zh: 阿萨出生于冰岛，但和她的小弟弟一起被送去领养。

sentences.en: Her brother stayed in Iceland while Arsa was adopted by a family in Long Island and raised in the United States.
sentences.zh: 她的弟弟留在了冰岛，而阿萨被长岛的一个家庭收养，并在美国长大。

sentences.en: She maintained a connection with Iceland, however, and travelled there regularly with her family to visit relatives
sentences.zh: 然而，她与冰岛保持着联系，并经常与家人一起去那里探亲。

sentences.en: It was a difficult upbringing
sentences.zh: 那是一段艰难的成长经历。

sentences.en: Asa struggled with having been adopted, feeling unloved, unwanted and like a perpetual outsider
sentences.zh: 阿萨对被领养感到挣扎，觉得不被爱、不被需要，像个永远的局外人。

sentences.en: When she was 16 years old, she was sexually assaulted by a boy in her neighbourhood
sentences.zh: 16岁时，她被邻居的一个男孩性侵。

sentences.en: Struggling in the aftermath of the assault, Asa attempted suicide
sentences.zh: 在遭受侵犯后的痛苦中，阿萨曾试图自杀。

sentences.en: She later left high school and began working at a 7-11
sentences.zh: 她后来退学，开始在7-11便利店工作。

sentences.en: Her life would change when she met Rex Hewerman
sentences.zh: 当她遇到雷克斯·赫尔曼时，她的人生发生了改变。

sentences.en: Their paths first crossed when they were both 18 and Hewerman was at college
sentences.zh: 他们第一次交集是在两人18岁、赫尔曼上大学的时候。

sentences.en: Arsa was attracted to Hewerman's 6 foot 4 height and thought he was handsome
sentences.zh: 阿萨被赫尔曼6英尺4英寸的身高所吸引，觉得他很帅。

sentences.en: As she would later tell filmmakers for the documentary series House of Secrets She fell madly in love with him
sentences.zh: 正如她后来在纪录片系列《秘密之家》中告诉制片人的那样，她疯狂地爱上了他。

sentences.en: But then she met another man who became her first husband.
sentences.zh: 但后来她遇到了另一个男人，并成为了她的第一任丈夫。

sentences.en: The marriage deteriorated after Arsa gave birth to a son named Christopher who had developmental disabilities.
sentences.zh: 在阿萨生下患有发育障碍的儿子克里斯托弗后，婚姻开始恶化。

sentences.en: Arsa wanted to leave her husband and when he made it clear he wasn't going to make it that easy for her, she reached out to Hulman for support.
sentences.zh: 阿萨想离开丈夫，当丈夫明确表示不会轻易放手时，她向赫尔曼寻求支持。

sentences.en: The two became romantically involved, and in November of 1995, Arsa and Christopher moved in to the Massapequa Park residence with Hjorman.
sentences.zh: 两人开始恋爱，1995年11月，阿萨和克里斯托弗搬进了赫尔曼在马萨皮夸公园的住所。

sentences.en: A few months later, Arsa became pregnant and the couple decided to get married.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，阿萨怀孕了，两人决定结婚。

sentences.en: Their wedding was held in Sweden on April 13, 1996.
sentences.zh: 他们的婚礼于1996年4月13日在瑞典举行。

sentences.en: Later that year, their daughter Victoria was born.
sentences.zh: 同年晚些时候，他们的女儿维多利亚出生了。

sentences.en: To Asa, Hjormann was a saviour who rescued her and her son in their greatest hour of need.
sentences.zh: 对阿萨来说，休尔曼是救命恩人，在他们最需要帮助的时候拯救了她和她的儿子。

sentences.en: Marrying him was the beginning of the life she had always wanted.
sentences.zh: 嫁给他，开启了她一直向往的生活。

sentences.en: As the years passed, Asa still travelled back to Iceland on occasion, typically in the summer months.
sentences.zh: 随着岁月流逝，阿萨偶尔还是会回冰岛，通常是在夏季。

sentences.en: Her children went with her, but her husband didn't.
sentences.zh: 她的孩子们会陪她一起去，但她丈夫不会。

sentences.en: Construction in New York was often at its busiest over the summer, so he needed to remain at home to work
sentences.zh: 纽约的建筑工程在夏季往往最繁忙，所以他需要留在家里工作。

sentences.en: He would also take advantage of the house being empty to make internal improvements here and there
sentences.zh: 他还会利用家里没人的机会，对房子进行一些内部改造。

sentences.en: Rex Hewman enjoyed woodworking, which he'd learnt from his father, and put this skill to good use
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·休尔曼喜欢木工，这是他从父亲那里学来的，他很好地利用了这项技能。

sentences.en: Once he crafted an intricate dollhouse as a gift for his daughter
sentences.zh: 有一次，他亲手制作了一个精致的玩偶屋作为送给女儿的礼物。

sentences.en: But despite his career as an architect and his carpentry skills, he didn't maintain the exterior of the home at all.
sentences.zh: 但尽管他是一名建筑师，也拥有木工手艺，他却完全没有维护过房子的外观。

sentences.en: While other houses in the upscale neighbourhood were typically well-maintained, from the outside, the Hulman residence looked increasingly shabby and ramshackle as years passed.
sentences.zh: 虽然这个高档社区的其他房子通常都维护得很好，但随着时间的推移，休尔曼的住所从外面看显得越来越破旧不堪。

sentences.en: Paint faded and peeled from the exterior wood siding and the shingles on the roof looked worn.
sentences.zh: 外墙木板上的油漆褪色剥落，屋顶的瓦片也显得破损。

sentences.en: The yard was overgrown with weeds in contrast to the more manicured gardens of neighbouring properties.
sentences.zh: 与邻居们修剪整齐的花园相比，院子里杂草丛生。

sentences.en: It became the sort of house parents told their children to avoid while trick-or-treating at Halloween.
sentences.zh: 它成了那种父母会告诉孩子万圣节讨糖时要避开的房子。

sentences.en: Sometimes Hewerman could be seen chopping wood in the front yard while scowling.
sentences.zh: 有时可以看到休尔曼在前院一边皱着眉头，一边劈柴。

sentences.en: Once he threatened to slash a neighbour's tyres because he didn't like the way they parked their truck.
sentences.zh: 有一次，他威胁要划破邻居的轮胎，因为他不喜欢他们停卡车的方式。

sentences.en: He wasn't someone who invited neighbourly conversations.
sentences.zh: 他不是那种会主动与邻居攀谈的人。

sentences.en: When the task force responsible for the Gilgo Beach investigation identified Rex Hewerman as a person of interest
sentences.zh: 当负责吉尔戈海滩调查的特别工作组将雷克斯·休尔曼确定为嫌疑人时，

sentences.en: in March of 2022, they set about obtaining search warrants and subpoenas for cell phone records and other evidence to verify their suspicions.
sentences.zh: 在2022年3月，他们开始申请搜查令，并传唤手机记录和其他证据以核实他们的怀疑。

sentences.en: The fact that he'd owned the same distinctive vehicle as the individual who'd last been seen with Amberlynn Costello gave them strong grounds to
sentences.zh: 他拥有与最后一次见到安珀琳·科斯特洛时那个人所驾驶的同款独特车辆，这给了他们充分的理由，

sentences.en: go off, as did the location of his home and office.
sentences.zh: 以及他家和办公室的位置，都让他们展开了调查。

sentences.en: One thing that the task force quickly established via travel records was that Rex Heuermann's wife had been out of the country on some significant dates.
sentences.zh: 特别工作组通过旅行记录迅速确定的一件事是，雷克斯·休尔曼的妻子在一些重要日期都不在国内。

sentences.en: On Wednesday July 8 2009, Arsa Elrup and her children flew to Iceland for a five-week vacation.
sentences.zh: 2009年7月8日星期三，阿萨·埃勒鲁普和她的孩子们飞往冰岛度假五周。

sentences.zh: 保险库看起来很可能是他实施这些罪行的地方，因为它既隔音又安全。

sentences.en: Behind a solid iron door with a combination lock, they discovered a walk-in vault that held a huge arsenal of firearms, far beyond the 92 handguns Hewman had permits for.
sentences.zh: 地下室的另一部分是一个房间，那是休尔曼童年的卧室，里面仍然摆着一张床，但非常杂乱。

sentences.en: He had started building the collection when he was 18 years old.
sentences.zh: 它还有一组通往外面院子的楼梯。

sentences.en: A total of 279 firearms were removed from the property, including antique weapons, long guns, 15 unregistered assault rifles, and at least
sentences.zh: 那个房间的后部连接着一个小小的隐藏隔间。

sentences.en: 26 unregistered handguns.
sentences.zh: 看起来，虽然休尔曼房子的外观被任由其慢慢破败，但房子内部却完成了几次翻新。

sentences.en: Investigators didn't believe Hewman had used the firearms against any of his victims, but the vault he had specially designed and built for their storage was another matter.
sentences.zh: 调查人员得知，在2009年7月他的家人去冰岛期间，雷克斯·休尔曼改造了其中一个浴室。

sentences.en: It sat directly under the basement stairs and was soundproofed.
sentences.zh: 这次翻新也恰逢梅丽莎·巴塞洛缪遇害的时间。

sentences.en: Hewerman kept the vault locked at all times and his family members were only allowed in there under his supervision.
sentences.zh: 休尔曼拆除了旧浴室里的所有东西，然后重新铺设了瓷砖并安装了全新的管道。

sentences.en: Investigators suspected that he had taken his victims back to his home and held them there for a time before murdering them and disposing of their remains.
sentences.zh: 有他购买物品的收据，日期是2009年7月12日，即梅丽莎失踪两天后。

sentences.en: The vault appeared to be a likely place where he would have carried out these crimes as it was soundproofed and secure.
sentences.zh: 调查人员怀疑这次翻新是为了掩盖她被谋杀的证据。

sentences.en: In another part of the basement was a room that had been Heuermann's childhood bedroom, which still had a bed set up but was very cluttered.
sentences.zh: 他们切开了乙烯基浴缸和地砖的部分，寻找血迹。

sentences.en: It also had a set of stairs leading up to the yard outside.
sentences.zh: 他们切开了乙烯基浴缸和地砖的部分，寻找血迹。

sentences.en: Adjoining the rear of that room was a small hidden compartment.
sentences.zh: 他们切开了乙烯基浴缸和地砖的部分，寻找血迹。

sentences.en: It also appeared that while the exterior of the Hewman house had been left to slowly fall into disrepair, several renovations had been completed inside the home.
sentences.zh: 他们切开了乙烯基浴缸和地砖的部分，寻找血迹。

sentences.en: Investigators learnt that while his family was away in Iceland in July of 2009, Rex Hewman had remodelled one of the bathrooMs.
sentences.zh: 他们切开了乙烯基浴缸和地砖的部分，寻找血迹。

sentences.en: This renovation also coincided with the murder of Melissa Bartholomew.
sentences.zh: 他们切开了乙烯基浴缸和地砖的部分，寻找血迹。

sentences.en: Hewerman had torn out everything from the old bathroom, then retiled it and installed all new plumbing.
sentences.zh: 他们切开了乙烯基浴缸和地砖的部分，寻找血迹。

sentences.en: There were receipts from his purchases dated July 12, 2009, two days after Melissa went missing.
sentences.zh: 他们切开了乙烯基浴缸和地砖的部分，寻找血迹。

sentences.en: Investigators suspected the renovation had been done to conceal evidence of her murder.
sentences.zh: 他们切开了乙烯基浴缸和地砖的部分，寻找血迹。

sentences.en: They cut up parts of the vinyl bathtub and the floor tiles, looking for traces of blood.
sentences.zh: 他们切开了乙烯基浴缸和地砖的部分，寻找血迹。

sentences.en: It has not been publicly confirmed whether any was found.
sentences.zh: 目前尚未公开证实是否发现了任何相关物品。

sentences.en: A press conference was held the day after Rex Hewerman's arrest to announce that a suspect in the Gilgo Beach murders had finally been apprehended.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·休尔曼被捕后的第二天举行了新闻发布会，宣布吉尔戈海滩连环谋杀案的一名嫌疑人终于落网。

sentences.en: Hewerman had only been charged with three of the murders at this stage, those of Melissa Bartholome, Megan Waterman and Amberlynn Costello.
sentences.zh: 当时休尔曼仅被指控犯有三起谋杀案，受害者分别是梅丽莎·巴塞洛缪、梅根·沃特曼和安伯琳·科斯特洛。

sentences.en: Investigators were seeking more evidence relating to the murder of Maureen Brainard Barnes and the other victims who had been killed during the 1990s and early 2000s
sentences.zh: 调查人员正在寻找与莫琳·布雷纳德·巴恩斯以及其他在20世纪90年代和21世纪初遇害的受害者相关的更多证据。

sentences.en: For that, they needed to work on the timelines when each crime was committed
sentences.zh: 为此，他们需要梳理每起案件的作案时间线。

sentences.en: It would ultimately emerge that Arsa Elrup and her children had also been away during the period in July 2007 when Maureen Brainard Barnes had gone missing
sentences.zh: 最终调查发现，阿萨·埃勒鲁普和她的孩子们在2007年7月莫琳·布雷纳德·巴恩斯失踪期间也曾外出。

sentences.en: In addition to searching Hewerman's home and office, investigators had obtained warrants to search some storage units he leased.
sentences.zh: 除了搜查休尔曼的住所和办公室外，调查人员还获得了搜查他所租用的一些储物单元的搜查令。

sentences.en: They'd recovered thousands of documents from those units, and amongst those records was a credit card statement that featured transactions made in Atlantic City, New Jersey,
sentences.zh: 他们从这些单元中找回了数千份文件，其中一份信用卡账单显示了2007年7月在新泽西州大西洋城进行的交易。

sentences.en: in July 2007.
Arsa had taken the kids there for a holiday from July 6 to July 20.
sentences.zh: 阿萨曾于7月6日至7月20日带孩子们去那里度假。

sentences.en: Hewerman had joined them for the second week of the vacation, arriving on July 13.
sentences.zh: 休尔曼在假期第二周加入了他们，于7月13日抵达。

sentences.en: Maureen had gone missing on July 9.
sentences.zh: 莫琳是在7月9日失踪的。

sentences.en: Investigators now had evidence that on each occasion that one of the Gilgo Four had been murdered, Rex Hewerman had his home entirely to himself.
sentences.zh: 调查人员现在掌握了证据，证明在“吉尔戈四人组”中每一位受害者遇害时，雷克斯·休尔曼都是独自一人在家。

sentences.en: Maureen's last known location was Penn Station, which was just a few blocks away from Rex Hewerman's office.
sentences.zh: 莫琳最后一次被确认的地点是宾夕法尼亚车站，距离雷克斯·休尔曼的办公室仅几个街区之遥。

sentences.en: She had been found with a leather belt that was used to bind her ankles, and the belt was embossed with the initials H.M.
sentences.zh: 人们发现她时，她脚踝上绑着一条皮带，皮带上压印着“H.M.”的缩写。

sentences.en: or W.H.
sentences.zh: 或者“W.H.”。

sentences.en: The initials W.H.
sentences.zh: 缩写“W.H.”。

sentences.en: would be a match for Hewman's grandfather, William, who died in 1964.
sentences.zh: 与休尔曼于1964年去世的祖父威廉的名字相符。

sentences.en: Tied in the buckle of the belt was a hair, which was 7.9 trillion times more likely to have come from Arsar Elrup than from a random, unrelated person.
sentences.zh: 皮带扣上系着一根头发，经鉴定，这根头发来自阿萨·埃勒鲁普的可能性比来自随机无关人员的可能性高出7.9万亿倍。

sentences.en: About six months after Rex Heumann's initial arrest, he was officially charged with the murder of Maureen Brainard Barnes on Tuesday, January 16, 2024.
sentences.zh: 在雷克斯·休尔曼最初被捕约六个月后，他于2024年1月16日星期二被正式指控谋杀莫琳·布雷纳德·巴恩斯。

sentences.en: But investigators believed he was responsible for more murders than those of the Gilgo Four.
sentences.zh: 但调查人员认为，他所犯下的谋杀案远不止“吉尔戈四人组”这几起。

sentences.en: There were still six other victims they suspected he was responsible for.
sentences.zh: 他们怀疑还有另外六名受害者也是他所为。

sentences.en: During the raids of Heumann's home and office, more than 400 electronic devices had been seized, including phones, laptops and hard drives.
sentences.zh: 在搜查休尔曼的住所和办公室期间，警方查获了400多件电子设备，包括手机、笔记本电脑和硬盘。

sentences.en: Stored on the devices were photos and videos of extreme pornography and violent content dating back to 1994.
sentences.zh: 这些设备中存储着自1994年以来的极端色情和暴力内容的照片及视频。

sentences.en: Hewerman had saved images he'd found of decapitated bodies, women bound with rope, mutilated breasts and child sexual abuse material.
sentences.zh: 休尔曼保存了他找到的断头尸体、被绳索捆绑的女性、残缺的乳房以及儿童性虐待素材的图像。

sentences.en: There was also evidence that he had viewed Amberlynn Costello's back page ad mere hours before his first encounter with her on September 1, 2010.
sentences.zh: 还有证据表明，他在2010年9月1日首次与安伯琳·科斯特洛见面仅几小时前，就浏览过她的“Backpage”广告。

sentences.en: But not all of Hewerman's online and tech activities were accessible.
sentences.zh: 但休尔曼并非所有的在线和技术活动都能被查到。

sentences.en: He'd searched online for directions to wipe data from a computer and had purchased software that enabled him to shred digital files.
sentences.zh: 他曾在网上搜索如何清除电脑数据，并购买了能够粉碎数字文件的软件。

sentences.en: There was evidence that he'd used this software on July 9, 2009, right before he met up with Melissa Bartholomew.
sentences.zh: 有证据表明，他在2009年7月9日，即与梅丽莎·巴塞洛缪见面之前，就使用了该软件。

sentences.en: Investigators believed he'd used the software to remove any evidence that he'd viewed her online advertisement
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为他使用该软件是为了删除他曾浏览过她在线广告的任何证据。

sentences.en: Heuermann's devices were handed over to forensic experts who might be able to recover some of the deleted information
sentences.zh: 休尔曼的设备被移交给了法医专家，他们或许能恢复部分被删除的信息。

sentences.en: During the analysis of a hard drive taken from Heuermann's basement
sentences.zh: 在分析从休尔曼地下室取出的硬盘时，

sentences.en: Investigators recovered a Microsoft Word document that had been deleted titled HK2002-04
sentences.zh: 调查人员恢复了一份名为“HK2002-04”的已删除Microsoft Word文档。

sentences.en: The original document was created in the year 2000 and had been named HK2000-03
sentences.zh: 原始文档创建于2000年，命名为“HK2000-03”。

sentences.en: Investigators suspected that Hewerman had renamed and updated the document over time to refer to impending years
sentences.zh: 调查人员怀疑休尔曼随着时间的推移重命名并更新了该文档，以指向即将到来的年份。

sentences.en: As investigators read the file, they realised it referred to the planning and carrying out of murder
sentences.zh: 当调查人员阅读该文件时，他们意识到它涉及谋杀的策划与实施。

sentences.en: HK stood for the words Hunt and Kill
sentences.zh: “HK”代表“狩猎与杀戮”（Hunt and Kill）。

sentences.en: There were four columns on the first page, with the headings Problems, Supplies, DS, and TRG.
sentences.zh: 第一页有四列，标题分别为“问题”、“补给”、“弃尸地点”和“目标”。

sentences.en: Beneath the word Problems was a long list that included DNA, tyre marks, bloodstains, fingerprints, witness, hair and fibre,
sentences.zh: 在“问题”一词下方是一长串列表，包括DNA、轮胎痕迹、血迹、指纹、证人、毛发和纤维，

sentences.en: and other items that could result in a killer being identified.
sentences.zh: 以及其他可能导致杀手身份暴露的物品。

sentences.en: The list for supplies mentioned things like rope, hairnets, police scanner and medical gloves
sentences.zh: “补给”列表提到了绳子、发网、警察扫描仪和医用手套等物品。

sentences.en: Investigators believed the column titled DS referred to dump sites
sentences.zh: 调查人员认为标题为“DS”的列指的是“弃尸地点”（Dump Sites）。

sentences.en: TRG appeared to be a reference to targets
sentences.zh: “TRG”似乎是指“目标”（Targets）。

sentences.en: Featuring on that list were the words
sentences.zh: 该列表上还出现了这样的话：

sentences.en: Small is good
sentences.zh: “小即是好”。

sentences.en: Beneath this first page were more lists that related to planning and preparing for a murder and what to do afterwards.
sentences.zh: 在这第一页下方还有更多列表，涉及谋杀的规划、准备以及事后处理。

sentences.en: Hewerman mentioned doing reconnaissance, looking out for surveillance cameras and checking the weather well in advance of a murder.
sentences.zh: 休尔曼提到了进行侦察、留意监控摄像头以及在谋杀前提前查看天气。

sentences.en: Then, closer to the event, he would set up a stage and a holding area where a victim would be suspended from the ceiling or bound to a table.
sentences.zh: 然后，在临近作案时，他会搭建一个舞台和一个拘留区，受害者会被悬挂在天花板上或绑在桌子上。

sentences.en: This setup was consistent with the sorts of extreme bondage pornography that had been found on his devices.
sentences.zh: 这种布置与在他设备中发现的各类极端捆绑色情内容相吻合。

sentences.en: The final column was how he would cover his tracks, by changing car tyres, burning and disposing of items, and having a story set for where he'd been at the time
sentences.zh: 最后一列是他如何掩盖行踪，包括更换汽车轮胎、焚烧和处理物品，并为自己当时所在的位置准备好一套说辞。

sentences.en: Further down the document, a section titled Body Prep described how to remove evidence from a victim and prevent their identification
sentences.zh: 在文档的下方，一个名为“尸体处理”的部分描述了如何清除受害者身上的证据并防止其身份被识别。

sentences.en: Some of the items on this list included remove ID marks, tattoos and remove head and hands
sentences.zh: 该列表中的一些项目包括：去除身份标识、纹身，以及切除头部和双手。

sentences.en: The year that this document had been written and some of the items featured on Hewman's lists made investigators more certain than ever he was responsible for more of the victims
sentences.zh: 这份文档的撰写年份以及休尔曼列表中的一些项目，使调查人员比以往任何时候都更确信他应对更多的受害者负责。

sentences.zh: 《案件档案》稍后回来。

sentences.en: Jessica Taylor was one of two victims whose partial remains were found near Gilgo Beach, while the rest of her body was left in a wooded area about 45 miles away.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡·泰勒是两名部分遗骸在吉尔戈海滩附近被发现的受害者之一，而她身体的其他部分被遗弃在约45英里外的一片林区。

sentences.en: 20-year-old Jessica had gone missing on Monday July 21, 2003, and her body was found five days later in Manorville.
sentences.zh: 20岁的杰西卡于2003年7月21日星期一失踪，五天后她的尸体在马诺维尔被发现。

sentences.en: Her breasts had been mutilated and she was missing her head, hands and forearMs.
sentences.zh: 她的乳房遭到毁坏，头部、双手和前臂缺失。

sentences.en: Most of these body parts were found almost eight years later during the extensive search along Ocean Parkway.
sentences.zh: 这些身体部位中的大部分是在近八年后，沿着海洋大道进行大规模搜查时被发现的。

sentences.en: While some close to the investigation had believed a different killer was behind Jessica's murder, others suspected that her murderer had also killed the Gilgo Four.
sentences.zh: 虽然一些接近调查的人士认为另有凶手杀害了杰西卡，但其他人怀疑她的凶手也杀害了“吉尔戈四人组”。

sentences.en: He'd just changed his methodology.
sentences.zh: 他只是改变了作案手法。

sentences.en: There were other examples of the killer honing his methods over time.
sentences.zh: 还有其他例子表明凶手随着时间的推移不断磨练自己的手段。

sentences.en: For example, he'd initially not had a problem with victims bringing their cell phones on dates, but eventually began instructing them to leave their phones at home.
sentences.zh: 例如，他最初并不介意受害者在约会时携带手机，但最终开始指示她们把手机留在家里。

sentences.en: Probably because he realised that cell data allowed investigators to track a device's general location.
sentences.zh: 这可能是因为他意识到手机数据可以让调查人员追踪到设备的常规位置。

sentences.en: After the news reported that Melissa Bartholomew's killer had taunted her youngest sister with phone calls, he ceased doing that as well.
sentences.zh: 在新闻报道称梅丽莎·巴塞洛缪的凶手曾用电话骚扰她最小的妹妹后，他也停止了这种行为。

sentences.en: The planning document Rex Hewerman had written up for the years 2002 to 2004 appeared to confirm the theory that he had changed his methodology over time.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·休尔曼为2002年至2004年编写的规划文档似乎证实了他随时间改变作案手法的理论。

sentences.en: This was a man who planned meticulously and adapted along the way.
sentences.zh: 这是一个行事缜密、不断调整策略的人。

sentences.en: Jessica Taylor had been identified in 2003 by a distinctive tattoo which her killer had tried to remove by cutting it repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡·泰勒在2003年被确认身份，依据是一个独特的纹身，凶手曾试图通过反复切割来去除它。

sentences.en: Luckily, medical examiners had been able to reconstruct the tattoo.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，法医能够重建该纹身。

sentences.en: Hewerman's office was also just a few blocks from where Jessica had been known to work and, once again, his family had been out of state at the time of the murder,
sentences.zh: 休尔曼的办公室距离杰西卡工作的地方也仅几个街区，而且再一次，他的家人在谋杀案发生时都在州外，

sentences.en: vacationing with some friends in Vermont from July 20 until July 27.
sentences.zh: 从7月20日到7月27日在佛蒙特州与朋友度假。

sentences.en: Hewerman had stayed home to work.
sentences.zh: 休尔曼留在家中工作。

sentences.en: Further forensic analysis of Hewerman's devices revealed that on July 28, 2003, two days after Jessica was found, he'd accessed an article about the case headlined,
sentences.zh: 对休尔曼设备的进一步法医分析显示，在2003年7月28日，即杰西卡被发现两天后，他访问了一篇关于该案的文章，标题为：

sentences.en: Cops Seek Help in IDing Manneville Body.
sentences.zh: “警方寻求帮助以确认马诺维尔尸体身份”。

sentences.en: The article revealed that about 13 hours before
sentences.zh: 文章透露，在杰西卡尸体被发现约13小时前，

sentences.en: Jessica's body was found, a witness who'd been in the area had noticed a dark-coloured
sentences.zh: 一名在该地区的目击者注意到一辆深色的

sentences.en: Chevrolet Avalanche backed up in the same wooded area, the same kind of vehicle that
sentences.zh: 雪佛兰Avalanche倒车停在同一片林区，这正是

sentences.en: Hewerman owned.
sentences.zh: 休尔曼拥有的那种车型。

sentences.en: He later deleted that online activity and searched for a new Chevrolet Avalanche in bright blue or white, despite his dark green vehicle being just one year old at the time.
sentences.zh: 他后来删除了该在线活动，并搜索了亮蓝色或白色的新款雪佛兰Avalanche，尽管他那辆深绿色汽车当时才买了一年。

sentences.en: Then he deleted that search as well.
sentences.zh: 然后他也删除了那次搜索记录。

sentences.en: When Jessica Taylor's body was first examined, investigators recovered a human hair from beneath the plastic sheet she was lying on.
sentences.zh: 当杰西卡·泰勒的尸体首次接受检查时，调查人员在她躺着的塑料布下发现了一根人类毛发。

sentences.en: Although it was believed that the hair had come from a Caucasian man's head,
sentences.zh: 虽然当时认为这根毛发来自一名白人男性的头部，

sentences.en: DNA testing capabilities weren't advanced enough in 2003 to test it further.
sentences.zh: 但2003年的DNA检测能力尚不足以进行进一步测试。

sentences.en: By 2024, however, significant advances in technology allowed forensic experts to develop a DNA profile from the hair.
sentences.zh: 然而到了2024年，技术的重大进步使法医专家能够从这根毛发中提取出DNA图谱。

sentences.en: It overwhelmingly pointed to the source being Rex Hewerman

sentences.en: The other victim recovered in both Manaville and Ocean Parkway was 24-year-old Valerie Mack who had only recently been identified via genetic genealogy
sentences.zh: 在马诺维尔和海洋大道两处被发现的另一名受害者是24岁的瓦莱丽·麦克，她最近才通过基因谱系学被确认身份。

sentences.en: Valerie had been murdered between September and November of 2000 and a hunter's dog had found her body wrapped in garbage bags
sentences.zh: 瓦莱丽在2000年9月至11月间遇害，一只猎犬发现了她被包裹在垃圾袋中的尸体，

sentences.zh: 休尔曼独自住在他从小长大的房子里。

sentences.zh: 他于次年从母亲手中买下了这栋房子。

sentences.en: This meant that Rex Hewerman had started killing at least seven years earlier than previously believed, shortly after his 30th birthday.
sentences.zh: 这意味着雷克斯·休尔曼开始杀人的时间比之前认为的至少早了七年，就在他30岁生日后不久。

sentences.en: The timing also placed
sentences.zh: 这一时间点也使

sentences.zh: 休尔曼的犯罪行为处于长岛历史上一个引人注目的时期。

sentences.en: Serial killers Joel Rifkin and Robert Shulman had also been targeting sex workers on Long Island in the early 1990s.
sentences.zh: 连环杀手乔尔·里夫金和罗伯特·舒尔曼在20世纪90年代初也曾在长岛针对性工作者作案。

sentences.en: Rifkin was arrested just five months before Sandra Castilla was murdered, while Shulman continued killing until 1995.
sentences.zh: 里夫金在桑德拉·卡斯蒂利亚遇害前五个月被捕，而舒尔曼则一直杀人到1995年。

sentences.en: It was an unusual concentration of serial killers with similar victim profiles in the same place and time.
sentences.zh: 在同一时间和地点出现如此多受害者特征相似的连环杀手，实属罕见。

sentences.en: By the end of 2024, Rex Shulman had been charged with murdering seven women.
sentences.zh: 到2024年底，雷克斯·舒尔曼已被指控谋杀七名女性。

sentences.en: Investigators strongly suspected he was guilty of killing an eighth, Fire Island Jane Doe, whose skull and teeth were located near Gilgo Beach in 2011.
sentences.zh: 调查人员强烈怀疑他应对第八起谋杀案负责，即“火岛简·多伊”，她的头骨和牙齿于2011年在吉尔戈海滩附近被发现。

sentences.en: Those remains had been linked to a pair of severed legs that had been found in April 1996 in a garbage bag on Fire Island.
sentences.zh: 这些遗骸与1996年4月在火岛一个垃圾袋中发现的一双断腿有关。

sentences.en: In 2023, Fire Island Jane Doe was identified via genetic genealogy as a 34-year-old Manhattan woman named Karen Vergada.
sentences.zh: 2023年，“火岛简·多伊”通过基因谱系学被确认为34岁的曼哈顿女子凯伦·维加达。

sentences.en: Karen was believed to have been working as a sex worker when she went missing in mid-February 1996.
sentences.zh: 据信凯伦在1996年2月中旬失踪时是一名性工作者。

sentences.en: The last time anybody had heard from her was when she called her father on February 14 to wish him a happy birthday.
sentences.zh: 最后一次有人听到她的消息是2月14日，她打电话给父亲祝他生日快乐。

sentences.en: No missing persons report was filed at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时并没有提交失踪人口报告。

sentences.en: Almost exactly two months after she went missing,
sentences.zh: 在她失踪近两个月后，

sentences.zh: 雷克斯·休尔曼在瑞典与妻子阿萨·埃勒鲁普结婚。

sentences.en: Law enforcement, the media and the public were overwhelmed by the extent of Rex Hewerman's offending and wondered how many more murders he might have been behind.
sentences.zh: 执法部门、媒体和公众对雷克斯·休尔曼的犯罪程度感到震惊，并想知道他可能还犯下了多少起谋杀案。

sentences.en: As well as looking at other unsolved Long Island cases, investigators considered whether Rex Hewerman could be responsible for crimes in other states.
sentences.zh: 除了调查长岛其他未决案件外，调查人员还在考虑雷克斯·休尔曼是否应对其他州的犯罪负责。

sentences.en: In 2012, he'd given his Chevrolet Avalanche to his younger brother who lived in Chester,
sentences.zh: 2012年，他把自己的雪佛兰Avalanche送给了住在南卡罗来纳州切斯特的弟弟，

sentences.en: South Carolina.
sentences.zh: 南卡罗来纳州。

sentences.en: Hewerman also owned about 18 acres of land nearby.
sentences.zh: 休尔曼在附近还拥有约18英亩的土地。

sentences.en: Shortly after arresting
sentences.zh: 在逮捕休尔曼不久后

sentences.en: Hewerman, police seized the vehicle and searched it, looking for evidence of the crimes.
sentences.zh: 警方扣押了那辆车并进行了搜查，寻找犯罪证据。

sentences.en: Nothing of note was recovered, but Hewerman's connections to South Carolina led to speculation that he might have harmed women there as well.
sentences.zh: 虽然没有发现什么值得注意的东西，但休尔曼与南卡罗来纳州的联系引发了人们的猜测，认为他可能也在那里伤害过女性。

sentences.en: News reports compared unsolved cases in the area to Hewerman's crimes.
sentences.zh: 新闻报道将该地区的未决案件与休尔曼的罪行进行了对比。

sentences.en: Back in Long Island, some women who'd met Hewerman previously came forward to share their stories.
sentences.zh: 回到长岛，一些曾经见过休尔曼的女性站出来讲述了她们的故事。

sentences.en: A picture emerged of a man who seemed to delight in discussing the crimes he was now accused of.
sentences.zh: 一个男人的形象浮出水面，他似乎以讨论自己被指控的罪行而感到愉悦。

sentences.en: Shortly after Hewerman's arrest, a woman named Nikki Brass posted on TikTok about an encounter she'd had with him in 2015.

sentences.en: Nikki had been working as an escort on Long Island at that time when she met Rex Heuermann online.
sentences.zh: 妮基当时在长岛做伴游，她在网上遇到了雷克斯·休尔曼。

sentences.zh: 他们约好在杰斐逊港的一家餐厅见面，那里距离休尔曼在马萨佩夸公园的家有近一个小时的路程。

sentences.en: Nicky was immediately struck by how enormous Heuermann was.

sentences.en: They chatted for a little bit, then Heuermann asked Nicky, are you into true crime?

sentences.zh: 那名受害者因左乳房上的纹身而被戏称为“桃子”。调查人员发布了纹身的照片，希望它能促使认识她的人站出来，但没有得到任何可靠的线索。
