sentences.zh: 听着丈夫的话，阿萨觉得他并没有表现出任何悔意。

sentences.en: He cried at times, but she felt as though his tears were for her, not his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 他有时会哭，但她觉得他的眼泪是为她而流，而不是为他的受害者。

sentences.en: Experts believe that Hewerman deliberately chose a wife who was insecure and wouldn't challenge him.
sentences.zh: 专家认为，休尔曼特意选择了一位缺乏安全感且不会挑战他的妻子。

sentences.en: He had been briefly married before Asa and described his first wife as crazy and uncontrollable.
sentences.zh: 在阿萨之前，他曾有过一段短暂的婚姻，他形容第一任妻子疯狂且无法控制。

sentences.en: In contrast, Asa idolised him, believing every word he said and felt deep gratitude that he had chosen her.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，阿萨对他崇拜有加，相信他说的每一句话，并对他选择了自己感到深深的感激。

sentences.en: Speaking to a psychotherapist who was hired by Asa Elrub's lawyer,
sentences.zh: 在与阿萨·埃尔鲁布的律师聘请的心理治疗师交谈时，

sentences.en: Hewerman said he'd had dark thoughts about death, mutilation and violent sexual fantasies as a teenager but provided no explanation as to why these thoughts had started.
sentences.zh: 休尔曼说，他在青少年时期就曾有过关于死亡、肢解和暴力性幻想的阴暗想法，但没有解释这些想法为何产生。

sentences.en: He claimed he'd stopped killing after Amberlynn Costello because he was no longer experiencing gratification from his crimes.
sentences.zh: 他声称在安伯琳·科斯特洛之后就停止了杀戮，因为他从犯罪中不再感到满足。

sentences.en: The psychotherapist pushed back against this, pointing out that the discovery of the bodies on Gilgo Beach three months after Amber's murder
sentences.zh: 心理治疗师对此提出反驳，指出在安伯谋杀案发生三个月后，吉尔戈海滩尸体的发现，

sentences.en: shone a spotlight on the murders that hadn't existed before.
sentences.zh: 让这些谋杀案受到了前所未有的关注。

sentences.en: She believed Hewerman had only stopped out of fear of being caught.
sentences.zh: 她认为休尔曼停止杀戮仅仅是因为害怕被抓。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, April 6, 2026, 62-year-old Rex Hewellman appeared in the Suffolk County Court and pleaded guilty to the first-degree murder of Melissa Bartholomew, Megan Waterman,
sentences.zh: 2026年4月6日星期三，62岁的雷克斯·休尔曼出现在萨福克县法院，承认了一级谋杀梅丽莎·巴塞洛缪、梅根·沃特曼的罪名，

sentences.en: and Amberlynn Costello, and the second-degree murder of Maureen Brainard Barnes, Jessica Taylor, Valerie Mack, and Sandra Castilla.
sentences.zh: 以及安伯琳·科斯特洛的罪名，并承认了二级谋杀莫琳·布雷纳德·巴恩斯、杰西卡·泰勒、瓦莱丽·麦克和桑德拉·卡斯蒂利亚的罪名。

sentences.en: He also admitted to killing Karen Vergata, whose murder he hadn't been formally charged with.
sentences.zh: 他还承认杀害了凯伦·维加塔，尽管他此前并未因这起谋杀案被正式起诉。

sentences.en: After admitting to his crimes, Hulman concluded
sentences.zh: 在承认罪行后，休尔曼总结道：

sentences.en: There are no words I can say
sentences.zh: 我无话可说。

sentences.en: The words I would say have no meaning
sentences.zh: 我说的话没有任何意义。

sentences.en: In response, the judge retorted
sentences.zh: 法官回应道：

sentences.en: I know that you're sorry you got caught I assume that you're sorry for what you've done to your wife and children
sentences.zh: 我知道你是因为被抓而感到抱歉，我假设你对你对妻子和孩子所做的一切感到抱歉。

sentences.en: Are you a little bit sorry for what you did to these poor innocent women?
sentences.zh: 你对你对这些可怜无辜的女性所做的一切感到哪怕一点点抱歉吗？

sentences.en: Then he continued
sentences.zh: 随后他继续说道：

sentences.en: You've been described as a very big man, but you're a disgusting and despicable small man, if you're a man at all, and you're a coward.
sentences.zh: 你被描述为一个大块头，但你是一个令人作呕、卑鄙的小人，如果你还算是个男人的话，你就是一个懦夫。

sentences.en: Then he addressed the bailiffs, stating,
sentences.zh: 然后他转向法警，说道：

sentences.en: Alright, get him out of here.
sentences.zh: 好了，把他带走。

sentences.en: This prompted the families and loved ones of the victims who were present in the courtroom to burst out in cheers and applause.
sentences.zh: 这促使在法庭上的受害者家属和亲人爆发出欢呼和掌声。

sentences.en: One person chanted, Ogre, Ogre, a reference to Hewerman's distinctive physical appearance that had been crucial to his suspect description and identification.
sentences.zh: 有人高喊“食人魔，食人魔”，这是指休尔曼独特的体貌特征，这对他作为嫌疑人的描述和识别至关重要。

sentences.en: Hewerman has never admitted to killing Asian Do, which hasn't prevented many from believing that he is responsible for that crime as well as other cold cases.
sentences.zh: 休尔曼从未承认杀害过亚裔女子，但这并没有阻止许多人相信他对那起犯罪以及其他悬案负有责任。

sentences.en: Asian Do's murder remains an active homicide investigation.
sentences.zh: 亚裔女子的谋杀案仍是一项正在进行的凶杀案调查。

sentences.en: There are also dozens of unsolved murders involving women on Long Island, some of whom were sex workers.
sentences.zh: 长岛还有数十起涉及女性的未解谋杀案，其中一些是性工作者。

sentences.en: Rex Hewerman was sentenced to life in prison without the possibility of parole.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯·休尔曼被判处终身监禁，不得假释。

sentences.en: He received three life sentences for the first-degree murder charges and four 25-year-to-life sentences for the second-degree murder convictions,
sentences.zh: 他因一级谋杀罪被判处三项终身监禁，因二级谋杀罪被判处四项25年至终身监禁，

sentences.en: all of which will run consecutively.
sentences.zh: 所有刑期将连续执行。

sentences.en: On the day of Hewellman's sentencing, the court was packed with family members and loved ones of the women murdered, who were there to represent all of the victiMs.
sentences.zh: 在休尔曼宣判当天，法庭挤满了被谋杀女性的家属和亲人，他们代表了所有的受害者。

sentences.en: The exception was Karen Vergada, who had only been in sporadic contact with her father when she was killed, and he had died in 2022 before his daughter's case was solved.
sentences.zh: 唯一的例外是凯伦·维加塔，她在被杀时与父亲只有零星的联系，而她的父亲在女儿的案件侦破前已于2022年去世。

sentences.en: The family members berated Hewellman and mourned their lost loved ones.
sentences.zh: 家属们斥责了休尔曼，并哀悼他们失去的亲人。

sentences.en: Jasmine Robinson, a cousin of Jessica Taylor, told Hewerman You chose small women because you're nothing more than a weak, disgusting coward
sentences.zh: 杰西卡·泰勒的表亲贾斯敏·罗宾逊对休尔曼说：“你选择弱小的女性，因为你不过是一个软弱、令人作呕的懦夫。”

sentences.en: Valerie Mack's parents said that although justice had finally been done the damage Hewerman had inflicted on their family was irreparable
sentences.zh: 瓦莱丽·麦克的父母表示，虽然正义最终得到伸张，但休尔曼对他们家庭造成的伤害是无法弥补的。

sentences.en: Amanda Funderburg, the younger sister of Melissa Bartholomew who had received taunting phone calls from Hewerman when she was just 15
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎·巴塞洛缪的妹妹阿曼达·芬德伯格，曾在15岁时接到过休尔曼的骚扰电话，

sentences.en: spoke about the questions she'd lived with for a decade and a half.
sentences.zh: 她谈到了她生活了十五年的疑问。

sentences.en: I always wonder if it would have happened if I would have been there, would she still be here?
sentences.zh: 我总是想，如果当时我在场，这一切还会发生吗？她还会在这里吗？

sentences.en: Would she have been spared because you wouldn't have met her or because I would have known where she was going?
sentences.zh: 她会因为你没见过她而幸免于难吗？或者是因为我知道她要去哪里？

sentences.en: But those questions don't matter because you still took her from me, from all of us.
sentences.zh: 但这些问题都不重要了，因为你还是把她从我身边，从我们所有人身边夺走了。

sentences.en: Noticing that Hewerman was staring blankly at the table in front of him,
sentences.zh: 注意到休尔曼正茫然地盯着面前的桌子，

sentences.en: Amanda addressed him directly.
sentences.zh: 阿曼达直接对他说话。

sentences.en: You can look at me while I'm talking, she said.
sentences.zh: “我说话的时候你可以看着我，”她说。

sentences.en: It's been about 17 years since we spoke.
sentences.zh: 距离我们通话已经过去大约17年了。

sentences.en: Don't forget.
sentences.zh: 别忘了。

sentences.en: But Hewerman kept gazing down at the table as Amanda shared details of the lifelong trauma she and her family had endured.
sentences.zh: 但当阿曼达分享她和家人所承受的终身创伤的细节时，休尔曼依然盯着桌子。

sentences.en: How the calls he'd made to her caused unspeakable suffering.
sentences.zh: 他打给她的那些电话造成了无法言喻的痛苦。

sentences.en: I was 15.
sentences.zh: 我当时15岁。

sentences.en: 15 years old.
I know you don't care, she added.
sentences.zh: “我知道你不在乎，”她补充道。

sentences.en: I was robbed of my youth, robbed of my young adulthood, and I still feel robbed to this day.
sentences.zh: 我的青春被剥夺了，我的年轻成年时光被剥夺了，直到今天我仍感到被剥夺。

sentences.en: There were so many years that I didn't want to be on this earth anymore.
sentences.zh: 有很多年我都不想再活在这个世上了。

sentences.en: I would have never taken my own life, but it got to the point where I didn't care what happened to me.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会自杀，但到了后来，我不在乎自己会发生什么。

sentences.en: I simply didn't want to be here without her.
sentences.zh: 我只是不想在没有她的情况下留在这里。

sentences.en: Missy Cairn, the sister of Maureen Brainard Barnes, cried as she recalled the day when she learnt her sister had been murdered.
sentences.zh: 莫琳·布雷纳德·巴恩斯的妹妹米西·凯恩在回忆得知姐姐被谋杀的那天时哭泣起来。

sentences.en: She described being plagued by survivor's guilt and endless what-ifs, wondering if somehow
sentences.zh: 她描述自己被幸存者的内疚和无尽的“如果”所困扰，想知道是否以某种方式

sentences.en: Maureen could have been saved.
sentences.zh: 莫琳本可以获救。

sentences.en: It has taken me years to know the truth.
sentences.zh: 我花了多年时间才得知真相。

sentences.en: My actions did not cause my sister's death.
sentences.zh: 我的行为并没有导致我姐姐的死亡。

sentences.en: The guilt is not mine to carry, she said.
sentences.zh: 这份内疚不该由我来承担，”她说。

sentences.en: This burden belongs to Rex and Rex alone.
sentences.zh: 这个重担属于雷克斯，也只属于雷克斯。

sentences.en: I hope he's forced to sit with the reality and feel even a fraction of the weight, the trauma and the pain I've carried for so long.
sentences.zh: 我希望他被迫面对现实，感受到我长期以来所承受的重担、创伤和痛苦的哪怕一小部分。

sentences.en: Missy spent time telling the court about Maureen, who she described as a rare soul, intelligent and insightful.
sentences.zh: 米西花时间向法庭讲述了莫琳，她形容莫琳是一个罕见的灵魂，聪明且富有洞察力。

sentences.en: She had always been Missy's protector.
sentences.zh: 她一直是米西的保护者。

sentences.en: A statement was read aloud on behalf of Amberlynn Costello's sister, Kim, in which she credited
sentences.zh: 法庭宣读了一份代表安伯琳·科斯特洛的妹妹金的声明，她在声明中称赞

sentences.en: Amber with lighting the match that led to Hewerman's eventual downfall.
sentences.zh: 安伯点燃了导致休尔曼最终垮台的导火索。

sentences.en: Amber had gotten the better of Hewerman when she and her housemate Dave ripped him off the first time he visited.
sentences.zh: 当安伯和她的室友戴夫在休尔曼第一次拜访时骗了他，安伯就占了上风。

sentences.en: As Kim pointed out, this had likely ignited fits of rage in the egotistical narcissist Rex Hewerman,
sentences.zh: 正如金所指出的，这很可能激怒了自负的自恋者雷克斯·休尔曼，

sentences.en: prompting him to seek revenge against Amber the following night, despite having already been seen by Dave.
sentences.zh: 促使他在第二天晚上对安伯进行报复，尽管他已经被戴夫看到过。

sentences.en: This allowed a witness to pass along crucial details to police, which were key to identifying Hewerman.
sentences.zh: 这使得一名目击者能够将关键细节传达给警方，这对于识别休尔曼至关重要。

sentences.en: A statement was also read on behalf of Sandra Castillo's sister, Ruth, who had been waiting decades for justice for her sister.
sentences.zh: 法庭还宣读了一份代表桑德拉·卡斯蒂利亚的妹妹露丝的声明，她为姐姐的正义等待了数十年。

sentences.en: Ruth expressed her gratitude to law enforcement for solving her sister's case and the other women's cases as well.
sentences.zh: 露丝对执法部门侦破她姐姐的案件以及其他女性的案件表示感谢。

sentences.en: She recalled Sandra as a beautiful, intelligent woman with endless potential who cherished being a mother to her son.
sentences.zh: 她回忆说，桑德拉是一位美丽、聪明的女性，拥有无限的潜力，她非常珍惜作为儿子的母亲。

sentences.en: He had been the centre of her world and losing her at a young age had caused irreparable damage to him.
sentences.zh: 他是她世界的中心，在年轻时失去她对他造成了无法弥补的伤害。

sentences.en: My heart is with all the families, Ruth wrote, and it is my deepest hope that their loved
sentences.zh: “我的心与所有家庭同在，”露丝写道，“我最深切的希望是他们的亲人

sentences.en: ones will find peace and will honour their lives by living their best lives and may the children left behind carry on a beautiful legacy of their mothers.
sentences.zh: 能找到平静，通过过好自己的生活来纪念她们，愿留下的孩子们能延续她们母亲美好的遗产。”

sentences.en: Liliana Waterman, the daughter of Megan
sentences.zh: 梅根·沃特曼的女儿莉莉安娜·沃特曼，

sentences.en: Waterman, shared all of the things she had missed out on by having her mother taken from her.
sentences.zh: 分享了她因母亲被夺走而错过的所有事情。

sentences.en: She had been three years old when her mother was murdered and was now about 20.
sentences.zh: 她母亲被谋杀时她才三岁，现在大约20岁了。

sentences.en: She'd never experienced what it was like to be comforted by Megan after a bad day, to hear her advice, or be guided by her unconditional love.
sentences.zh: 她从未体验过在糟糕的一天后得到梅根安慰的感觉，从未听过她的建议，也从未得到过她无条件的爱。

sentences.en: After eventually learning the truth of what had happened to her mother, Liliana was tormented by knowing that Megan had only been doing escort work to
sentences.zh: 在最终得知母亲遭遇的真相后，莉莉安娜因得知梅根只是为了

sentences.en: provide a better life for her.
sentences.zh: 给她提供更好的生活而从事陪侍工作而感到痛苦。

sentences.en: Megan's mother had died in August of 2022, almost a year before
sentences.zh: 梅根的母亲于2022年8月去世，就在休尔曼被捕前一年左右。

sentences.en: Hewman's arreSt. She never got to see the capture of her daughter's killer or witness him being brought to justice.
sentences.zh: 她没能看到女儿的杀手被抓获，也没能见证他被绳之以法。

sentences.en: Megan's aunt, Elizabeth Meserve, spoke instead.
sentences.zh: 梅根的姨妈伊丽莎白·梅瑟夫代为发言。

sentences.en: Elizabeth said Megan had been repeatedly victimised, first by the man who trafficked her, and then by Rex Hewerman, who had access to Megan because of what her pimp had done.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白说，梅根一再成为受害者，先是被贩卖她的人，然后是雷克斯·休尔曼，他因为皮条客的行为而有机会接触到梅根。

sentences.en: I'm certain my niece fought as hard as she possibly could to come back to her daughter, who she loved with every fibre of her being.
sentences.zh: “我确信我的侄女尽了她最大的努力想回到她女儿身边，她用尽全身心地爱着她。”

sentences.en: She described Megan as funny, strong and devoted to her family and friends
sentences.zh: 她形容梅根风趣、坚强，对家人和朋友忠诚。

sentences.en: Elizabeth also used her platform to talk about the ways the families had been re-victimised by others after Hewerman
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白还利用这个平台谈论了在休尔曼被捕后，家属们如何被他人再次伤害。

sentences.en: First, by the corruption of former Suffolk County Police Chief James Burke and former District Attorney Thomas Spoter
sentences.zh: 首先是前萨福克县警察局长詹姆斯·伯克和前地方检察官托马斯·斯波特的腐败。

sentences.en: Under their watch, key evidence in the case had been ignored and assistance was rejected so that light couldn't be shone on their corruption.
sentences.zh: 在他们的监视下，案件的关键证据被忽视，援助被拒绝，这样他们的腐败就不会被曝光。

sentences.en: If they had done their jobs properly, the case might have been solved a decade earlier.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能妥善完成工作，这个案件可能早十年就破了。

sentences.en: In 2011, investigators already had the crucial information they needed to identify the Long
sentences.zh: 2011年，调查人员就已经掌握了识别长岛连环杀手所需的关键信息。

sentences.en: Island serial killer.
sentences.zh: 岛连环杀手。

sentences.en: Elizabeth had also felt re-victimised when she learnt that
sentences.zh: 当伊丽莎白得知休尔曼的家人将因参与一部关于该案件的纪录片系列而获得超过一百万美元的报酬时，她也感到再次受害。

sentences.en: Hewerman's family would be receiving more than a million dollars for participating in a documentary series on the case.
sentences.zh: 休尔曼的家人将因参与一部关于该案件的纪录片系列而获得超过一百万美元的报酬。

sentences.en: As she saw it, they were profiting from the crimes committed by their patriarch.
sentences.zh: 在她看来，他们是在从他们族长所犯下的罪行中获利。

sentences.en: Maureen's sister Missy agreed with Elizabeth, and the two women have formed the Gilgo Victims Committee with the intention of revising New York's Son of Sam law.
sentences.zh: 莫琳的妹妹米西同意伊丽莎白的观点，两人成立了吉尔戈受害者委员会，旨在修订纽约州的“山姆之子”法。

sentences.en: As it currently stands, criminals cannot profit from their crimes by speaking or writing about them, but a loophole allows their families to receive money for the same.
sentences.zh: 按照目前的规定，罪犯不能通过谈论或书写自己的罪行来获利，但一个漏洞允许他们的家人为此获得金钱。

sentences.en: Much has been made over the years about the fact that Heuermann's victims went unseen by so many for so long.
sentences.zh: 多年来，人们对休尔曼的受害者长期被忽视这一事实议论纷纷。

sentences.en: Law enforcement officers initially dismissed their disappearances, and when they were found, they reassured the general public that they had nothing to be afraid of.
sentences.zh: 执法人员最初对她们的失踪不予理睬，当她们被发现时，他们向公众保证没什么可担心的。

sentences.en: When journalist Robert Kolker wrote his definitive book about the case, he titled it Lost Girls as a nod to the way society had failed them.
sentences.zh: 当记者罗伯特·科尔克撰写关于此案的权威书籍时，他将其命名为《失踪女孩》，以暗示社会辜负了她们。

sentences.en: In her statement, Elizabeth Meserve addressed this aspect of the case and how Hewman had deliberately selected victims he saw as disposable.
sentences.zh: 在声明中，伊丽莎白·梅瑟夫谈到了案件的这一方面，以及休尔曼如何蓄意选择他认为可以随意处置的受害者。

sentences.en: She pointed out that the legacy of the eight women he murdered would go well beyond what he ever could have anticipated, stating,
sentences.zh: 她指出，他谋杀的八名女性的遗产将远远超出他所能预料的，并表示：

sentences.en: The prisoner's plan to erase Megan, Maureen, Melissa, Amber, Jessica, Valerie, Sandra and Karen backfired.
sentences.zh: 囚犯试图抹去梅根、莫琳、梅丽莎、安伯、杰西卡、瓦莱丽、桑德拉和凯伦的计划适得其反。

sentences.en: Because of his vile and cowardly actions, our loved ones will be spoken of for years to come with love and reverence.
sentences.zh: 因为他卑鄙和懦弱的行为，我们的亲人将在未来的岁月里被人们带着爱和敬意谈论。

sentences.en: Not only by their families and friends, but by millions of people around the world who now mourn their loss.
sentences.zh: 不仅是被她们的家人和朋友，还有全世界数百万现在为她们的离去而哀悼的人们。
